title: FPS Block Strike Dust2
description: Experience a classic team-based FPS battle in a block-style world with FPS Block Strike Dust2! Choose your team and fight in intense battles between Terrorists and Counter-Terrorists. Equip your weapon, move quickly through the Dust2-themed arena, take the right positions, and work together with your teammates to defeat the opposing team. Use your reflexes, aim carefully, and develop your strategy during competitive firefights. Enter the arena, ready your weapon, and join the action-packed FPS battle!

title: Rim Rebels 3v3
description: Grab two teammates and take the blacktop. Rim Rebels 3v3 is full-court street basketball with two hoops, a running clock and four short quarters. Hang in the air before you release a jumper, fake a pass to open the lane, throw an alley-oop to a cutting teammate or swat a shot at the rim. Play the CPU on Easy, Normal or Hard, jump into Quick Match online, or create a room and send the code to a friend. Every quarter starts with a jump ball and each team gets one Super Shot per quarter.

title: Blocktrail 2048
description: Run into a colourful blocky arena where every cube counts! Collect blocks, grow your number trail and chase down weaker rivals to steal their points. Keep your distance from stronger opponents—one wrong turn could end your run! Grab power-ups, race for the rare moving Golden Cube and push beyond 2048. Earn coins, unlock hats and trails, and build your own collection of eight blocky cars.

title: Ocean Dash
description: Ocean Dash is an exciting underwater adventure where you dive into the deep sea to catch rare fish and earn valuable rewards. Explore colorful ocean environments, collect as many fish as possible, use helpful power-ups, and stay alert for dangerous sharks. Test your speed, reflexes, and diving skills as each mission becomes more challenging. Dive deeper, discover ocean secrets, and become the ultimate sea hunter!

title: Fruit Box Sort
description: Sort colorful fruit boxes in a relaxing puzzle game. Tap open boxes to send fruit onto the conveyor belt and fill matching containers. Plan your moves, keep space on the belt, and discover 210 levels with mystery boxes, fruit barrels, ice and linked boxes. Use helpful boosters when you need a hand. Play with a mouse or touch. Progress is saved in your browser.

title: Goods Sort Match Puzzle
description: Goods Sort Match Puzzle is a colorful shelf-sorting game. Drag drinks, snacks, toys, and other goods between shelves, then line up three identical items to clear them. Each match opens space and reveals more products. Plan your moves, manage empty slots, and clear the board before the timer runs out. Enjoy varied shelf layouts and helpful boosters with mouse or touch controls. Progress is saved in the current browser.

title: Castle Crashers: Stolen Sun
description: Castle Crashers: Stolen Sun is a colorful 2D fantasy brawler across a kingdom robbed of daylight. Choose an elemental knight and follow 36 story stages with optional routes, lively enemies and boss encounters. Strike, jump and use elemental skills while discovering paths, collecting salvage and improving tools and armor. Checkpoint retries, persistent progress, touch controls and an original lively fantasy soundtrack keep the quest moving.

title: Kingmoon
description: Kingmoon is a 3D space action game. King Regulus rules the stars from his moon, and his robot and alien kingdoms hold every planet. You start with one small ship and one flag. Fly low over five worlds, each with its own rules: green Veyra, the ice of Glacia, the volcanoes of Pyra, the sandstorms of Sair and the machine planet Nucleon. Land, fight on foot and plant your flag to turn each sector to your side. Call your mech when the fight gets heavy. Modes and levels: 25 story missions in 5 systems, each system ending with a boss, plus the final war on the Kings Moon. Characters: four pilots, Lira and the robot commander Vexar. Earn crystals, upgrade and paint your ship in the hangar. Progress is saved automatically. 6 languages.

title: Nebula Marshal
description: Nebula Marshal is a 3D space-western survival shooter. Pick one of 6 heroes, land on a hostile planet and hold out against endless monster waves. Your guns fire automatically: move, dodge and grab crystals to level up. Stack 9 weapons and 16 modules, then evolve weapons into legendary forms like the Golden Six-Shooter. Every 2.5 minutes a WANTED bounty boss shows up, and the deadliest one arrives at 10:00. Conquer the Rust Wastes, Frost Frontier and Neon Canyon, raise your Wanted level for bigger rewards, complete daily contracts and spend credits on permanent upgrades in the Hangar.

title: Formula Apex Rush
description: Race Formula cars across 8 regions and 40 events. Beat THE BARON, survive rain, debris and surprises, upgrade your car and become Apex Champion!

title: Carletto Halloween Dreams
description: Carletto enters a Halloween dream of floating islands, haunted forests and glowing castles. Use his telescope to reveal mist-hidden paths and guide starlight through mirrors. Dodge chasing pumpkin creatures, collect 90 stars and explore 30 story stages plus six bonus dreams. Outsmart an old witch, a storm raven and a moonbound wolf, then face the giant Pumpkin Phantom in three battles. Defeat the nightmares and help Carletto wake to a new day.

title: Crazy Cart
description: Get ready for a fun and exciting cart adventure in Crazy Cart! Help your little blue character push and balance a cart filled with colorful shapes. Carefully collect, stack, and transport different objects while keeping everything balanced. Test your skills, avoid dropping items, and overcome challenging levels as you move forward. With simple controls, colorful 3D graphics, and fun physics-based gameplay, every level brings a new challenge. Can you keep your cart balanced and reach the finish line? Play Crazy Cart and enjoy a fun-filled adventure!

title: Storky Survivors
description: Play as Rookie Storky and survive swarms of the Glitchlings across 10 stages plus an endless mode. Pick weapons and upgrades, collect gems, beat giant bosses and grow stronger run after run.

title: Timber Truck: City Cargo Driver
description: **Timber Truck: Forest Cargo Driver** is an exciting truck driving and wood transportation game! Get behind the wheel of a powerful cargo truck and transport heavy wooden logs from the forest to their destination. Drive carefully through challenging roads, balance your cargo, avoid obstacles, and deliver the wood safely. Experience fun truck driving challenges and test your driving skills across different levels. **Game Features:** - Exciting wood transportation missions - Realistic truck driving gameplay - Challenging roads and environments - Cargo loading and delivery challenges - Smooth driving controls - Multiple levels to complete - Fu

title: Precision Parking: City Driver
description: **Precision Parking: City Driver** is an exciting 3D car parking game where you test your driving and parking skills! Drive through challenging parking levels, avoid obstacles, and park your car perfectly in the designated parking spot. Explore challenging parking environments, improve your steering skills, and complete every level without crashing. Are you ready to become a parking master? **Features:** - Realistic car driving experience - Challenging parking levels - Smooth and responsive controls - Different parking challenges - Fun and addictive gameplay - Test your precision driving skills

title: Cage Ballers Football
description: Step into the cage and take on the CPU in a fast, 3D small-sided football match. Choose a pitch, team kit, match length, camera and difficulty, then pass, sprint, tackle and shoot your way to victory. Play two halves and, if the score is level, go to golden goal. Switch players, watch goal replays and check match stats after the whistle. Supports keyboard and gamepad controls.

title: Spookily Stylish Duo
description: Two friends, Arelia and Tiara, are looking forward to autumn to meet her fully armed in style! Join the girls: try on fashionable autumn looks and choose accessories that will emphasize the character of each heroine. But do not limit yourself to the wardrobe! Light up the lights at the house, decorate the entrance and turn the courtyard into a cozy corner of a fairy tale. Let your imagination run wild and create a truly terrifyingly stylish duo!

title: Car Parking Master 3D
description: Test your driving skills in Car Parking Master 3D! Drive realistic cars and park them in tricky spots across different levels. Follow the signs, avoid obstacles, and complete each challenge with precision. Can you become the ultimate parking expert? Realistic 3D graphics Challenging parking levels Smooth and easy controls Multiple cars and environments Start your engine and park like a pro!

title: Modern Strike Shooting Game
description: Get ready for intense combat action in Modern Strike Shooting, an exciting shooting game where precision, quick reactions, and tactical skills are the keys to success. Enter the battlefield, aim carefully, and experience thrilling first-person shooter (FPS) gameplay designed for fans of action and combat games. Take on challenging shooting encounters, improve your aiming skills, and enjoy an action-packed gaming experience. Whether you love gun games, military combat, FPS shooters, or tactical action adventures, Modern Strike Shooting delivers an engaging experience for shooting game enthusiasts.

title: Oxy Arena
description: Oxy Arena is a fast online FPS in a blocky 3D world. Press Play to jump into a match with players from around the world, or create a private room and invite friends with a code. Modes: Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch (4 v 4), and Backrooms: Zombies, a solo survival mode with five waves of zombies in the endless yellow rooms. Practice against bots or on the target range. Maps: Downtown (a city with walk-in shops), Ruins, Orbital (a space station), Dungeon, Block Fort and the Backrooms. Guns: AK, SMG, shotgun, sniper and pistol. Chain headshots and multi-kills, level up, unlock gun skins and complete daily challenges. Plays on computers, phones

title: Color Coin Merge
description: Get hooked on this addictive coin-sorting game. Explore different ways to sort and discover repeating patterns. Use special power-ups to overcome obstacles and progress through increasingly tricky levels.

title: Nitrovenant 2
description: Drive through endless hordes of zombie workers in an armored car with a rooftop missile launcher. Your car fires on its own: you pick the lane, jump the potholes and hit the nitro to plow through the crowd. 120 stages across six places, from sunny fields and rainy forests to the desert, a frozen pass, a dead city and the Inferno. Every stage ends with a giant boss with its own moves. Wait for it to get dizzy and hit back. Pull off flips and barrel rolls on ramps, keep your combo going to unlock Fury mode, grab power-ups, rescue survivors and upgrade your weapon, armor and tires. Collect 12 cars, paint jobs and parts, finish daily challenges and missions, and see how far you can go in Endless mode.

title: Vlinder Garden Dress Princess
description: Vlinder Garden Dress Princess is a creative girls casual game combining fashion styling, handmade crafts, room design, and multiplayer creation challenges. As a dress-up game for girls, it allows you to customize characters, create cute designs, and build your own fantasy world. The game also includes relaxing makeover game features where you can experiment with different fashion combinations and create fresh new appearances.

title: Panda Run 1
description: Panda Run is an exciting running game where you jump, slide, dodge obstacles, and collect coins. Explore four unique biomes—Green Forest, Snow Mountain, Desert Ruins, and Lava Volcano—across 200 levels. Complete missions, unlock skins, and challenge yourself to achieve the highest score!

title: Turbo Boat Runner 3D
description: Get ready for an exciting high-speed water adventure in Turbo Boat Runner 3D! Take control of a powerful speedboat and race across beautiful blue waters at incredible speeds. Navigate through challenging paths, avoid obstacles, and master sharp turns as you rush through the waves. Enjoy stunning 3D visuals, thrilling boat-racing action, and an immersive water experience. Test your reflexes, improve your steering skills, and see how far you can go without crashing. Are you ready to become the ultimate speedboat champion? Start your engine and dive into the ultimate water racing adventure!

title: Stickman Skybow
description: Stickman Skybow is a fast-paced 2D archery game with two modes: Duel and Defense. Draw, aim and release to defeat distinctive bosses across changing floors, or hold back waves of enemies. Unlock bows, special arrows, heroes and permanent upgrades with coins earned through play. Day and night scenery alternates through the Duel floors. Play with mouse on desktop or touch in landscape on mobile.

title: SWAT OPS: Body camera
description: Aim. Shoot. Dominate! Fast first-person shooter with satisfying gunplay. Play solo against bots or team up with friends. MODES Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Gun Game, Zombies, Bomb, Co-op LEVELS Old-town streets, open fields and moody zones with dynamic time of day. ENEMIES Soldiers, marines, retro bad guys and zombie hordes. PROGRESSION Unlock weapons and skins, open loot boxes, finish daily tasks and climb the Battle Pass. Desktop and mobile. Jump in and play in seconds!

title: Needle Rush
description: Somebody lost their needles in a haystack. A really, really big haystack. Grab a beeping metal detector and dig! The closer you get, the faster it beeps. Sell the hay, buy better tools and research Fork Arms, conveyor belts, magnet scanners, balers, vacuum towers and drones to build a hay factory that eats a 286,000-bundle haystack for you. Find golden and cursed needles, collect 48 odd needles for your album, level up your barn, hit milestones, claim daily rewards and come back to a factory that kept working while you were away.

title: Mecha Screw 3D
description: Take apart colorful machines in Mecha Screw 3D! Remove exposed screws, fill matching color boxes, and plan ahead to keep your spare slots clear. Watch metal plates swing and fall as you uncover new moves. Solve 15 strategic puzzles, earn stars, and use Hint, Undo, Magnet, or Drill when you need a hand.

title: Furious GT Drift
description: Drift the floating arenas, smash snow, beat 7 mission types and a rival car in 51 arenas. Upgrade 8 cars, unlock skills and never touch the curb!

title: Nutty Rush Kart
description: Nutty Rush Kart is a colourful arcade kart racer starring the critters of Nutty Rush. Pick one of 12 racers, build your kart from bodies, wheels, side panels, nut launchers and glide wings, and race 40 tracks across 8 worlds. Collect nuts on the track and fire them at your rivals, drift through corners to charge a boost, hit the speed pads and win a five-race cup in every world.

title: Snake VS AI
description: Snake vs AI is a paper.io-style territory battle with a snake twist. Slither out of your land on a bright 3D island, draw a loop with your trail and close it back home to claim everything inside. AI snakes, each with its own personality, race you for the same ground. Touch an AIs trail to knock it out, but if any of them touches yours, youre out! Grab the most land before the timer ends, or take over half the island to win instantly. Win matches to climb from Beginner to Pro and Elite, where the maps get bigger and you face up to 10 AI snakes at once. Reach Elite to unlock Unlimited mode: no timer, just you against the AI until someone gets you. Collect coins, unlock colourful snake skins, and use speed boosts, a bigger starting base or a trail shield to turn the tables. Psst... type the right secret name and you might unlock a T-Rex or Dragon that stomps across the map! Steer with mouse, WASD or arrow keys, or drag on mobile.

title: Bus Master: Road Journey
description: Get behind the wheel of a powerful bus and explore busy city streets, highways, and challenging roads! Pick up passengers, navigate traffic, and reach your destinations safely in Busora: Highway Driver 3D. Test your driving skills and enjoy an exciting bus simulator adventure!

title: Mud Trails 4x4 Jeep Game
description: Get ready for an exciting offroad adventure in Mud Trails 4x4 Jeep! Drive powerful 4x4 jeeps across muddy tracks, rough terrain, and challenging offroad routes. Test your driving skills, maintain control on difficult paths, and experience the thrill of offroad driving in this adventure-packed jeep simulator. Take your 4x4 vehicle through challenging trails and enjoy the excitement of navigating uneven surfaces and muddy roads. Whether you enjoy jeep driving games, offroad racing, 4x4 vehicle simulators, or extreme driving challenges, Mud Trails 4x4 Jeep offers an engaging experience for offroad game fans.

title: Car Carrier Truck: Highway Master
description: # AutoHaul Truck Simulator 3D Get ready to experience the exciting world of heavy truck driving with **AutoHaul Truck Simulator 3D**, an engaging car transport truck driving game where precision, patience, and driving skills are the keys to success. Take control of a powerful transport truck, carry valuable cars across challenging roads, and complete exciting delivery missions while improving your driving abilities. Whether you enjoy truck simulator games, car carrier challenges, or realistic vehicle driving experiences, this game offers an enjoyable adventure for players who love driving big vehicles and transporting cars from one destinat

title: Vector Strike
description: Pilot your fighter through 10 neon wireframe sectors and take on 10 giant bosses. Dodge enemy fire, collect upgrades and build your arsenal with rear shots, missiles, shields and split fire. Break each boss’s weak points to expose its core, then finish it off. VECTOR STRIKE keeps the action fast, with short stages and autofire you can switch off for manual control.

title: Katana Zero: Borrowed Seconds
description: Katana Zero: Borrowed Seconds follows Rei through a neon city where stolen technology can bend time at the cost of memory. Explore authored rooms, slash enemies, reflect bullets, dash through danger and slow the action to plan your next move. Web Dev https://www.games.org.es/ Detailed environments, quick checkpoint retries, saved progress, mobile controls and an original electronic soundtrack support an atmospheric 2D sword-action story.

title: Castle Story Match3!
description: Dream Castle is an exciting match-3 puzzle game where you help a young princess bring her ruined castle back to its former glory. Game features: More than 100 exciting levels with gradually increasing difficulty. A magical transformation of the castle: walls, floors, and furniture are restored right before your eyes. An engaging plot with dialogues and new characters. Cleaning and interior design mechanics: choose a style, arrange the furniture, create coziness. Daily bonuses

title: Bus Jam   Sort Escape
description: Clear the traffic in Bus Jam - Sort Escape, a colorful single-player puzzle with 1,000 levels. Tap available buses to pick up passengers of the same color, manage limited road spaces, and merge three matching buses into a double-decker. Plan each move, use Clear, Shuffle and Magnet boosters when needed, and unlock pixel-art collections as you progress. Play with a mouse or touch controls. Progress is saved in the current browser.

title: GT Rush 2026
description: Race 8 brand-free GT cars on 3 circuits! 5 modes each, championship, drift, upgrades, skill tree & daily rewards. Built for speed by crazygamesup

title: Dead City: Zombie Survival
description: The city fell three days ago. Survive the night in a ruined, zombie-infested city, scavenge weapons and supplies, fight off hordes of the dead and find a way out before its too late. Explore abandoned streets, a forest camp and an industrial zone, use your flashlight in the dark and drive vehicles to escape. How long can you survive?

title: Teen Titans   Bad Guy
description: Team up with the Teen Titans in Teen Titans - Bad Guy! Dash into high-speed combat, defeat notorious villains across Jump City, unleash explosive special moves with Robin, Cyborg, Raven, Starfire, and Beast Boy, and save the city across action-packed levels!

title: Aliens Need Redheads
description: Aliens Need Redheads is a fast paced running platformer game where your play as shy guy who fell in love with her office crush. But just when hes about to give her a flower, her office crush gets kidnapped by an alien civilization. You need to get her back! Run and jump across tall buildings to rescue your crush. Collect the crystals to earn more life points and rescue the girl crush who is in distress. It a challenging double-jump game with love story and epic animation you will surely enjoy

title: DONT SPLASH
description: Dont Splash is a 3D horror platformer set in an endless abandoned pool. Jump from tile to tile through the fog and find the exit, but never fall in: a blind creature lives in the water and hunts by sound. One splash and it comes straight for you! Cross nine rooms of sinking tiles, rotating bridges, drifting floors and crushing walls, throw pebbles and bottles to lure the monster away, and photograph the hidden code to unlock the final door. Play Solo, or team up in 2 Player split-screen on one keyboard: revive your partner and escape together!

title: Puzzle Box: Connect
description: Connect the matching colored tiles by drawing paths across the grid. Fill the board without letting the paths overlap. Solve each puzzle to advance through the levels. Web Dev https://www.gamesx.com.es/

title: Stunt Witch 3
description: Fly into a magical Halloween adventure! Help a brave little witch recover the stars stolen by a mischievous ghost. Steer your broom through glowing rings, collect stars and potions, and dodge bats across 24 scrolling levels. Enjoy illustrated story scenes, storm effects, unlockable outfits and an endless mode. Watch out: touching a ring’s edge ends your flight!

title: Farming Tractor Game
description: Get ready to experience the exciting world of farming with Farming Tractor Game, an enjoyable tractor driving simulator where you can explore the countryside and take on farming challenges. Drive powerful tractors, work on farm fields, transport agricultural goods, and experience the daily activities of a hardworking farmer.

title: Streets of Rage: Neon District
description: Fight through eight neon-lit district chapters as Rhea or Vale in this 2D street brawler. Mix punches, kicks and airborne attacks, dodge enemy windups, grab and throw opponents and pick up weapons. Explore multiple scenes and confront district bosses while checkpoints save your progress. Web Dev https://www.kidsandgames.com/ Detailed illustrated fighters, city environments and an original electronic soundtrack bring the streets to life. Keyboard, mouse and mobile touch controls are supported.

title: 6x6 Offroad Jeep
description: Take control of a powerful 6x6 off-road jeep and conquer rugged mountain trails in 6x6 Offroad Jeep. Climb steep rocky slopes, cross uneven terrain and follow the course to reach the finish. Explore challenging hill-climb stages, manage your speed on dangerous inclines and keep all six wheels moving across rough ground. Web Dev https://www.juegos.org.es/ Switch camera views to find the best line through each obstacle and improve your driving on every run.

title: Slinky
description: **Slinky** is a challenging logic puzzle game where every step matters. Move across numbered tiles, avoid tiles that reach zero, and turn red and yellow tiles green to complete each level. Plan your route carefully, avoid dead ends, and use each tile wisely as puzzles become more complex. Test your strategy, logic, and problem-solving skills, master every tricky path, and conquer all the challenges in Slinky!

title: Geometry Arrow Wave Rush
description: Get ready to test your reflexes in Geometry Arrow Wave Rush! Control your arrow-shaped character and navigate through challenging obstacle-filled tracks in this fast-paced arcade game. Make sharp movements, pass through narrow gaps without hitting obstacles, and survive for as long as possible. As the speed increases, stay in control and change direction at the right moment. New obstacles and more challenging tracks await you. Improve your reflexes, beat your high score, and try to reach the longest distance in Geometry Arrow Wave Rush!

title: PuzzleMaster
description: Puzzle Master is an addictive connect puzzle game where you match blocks of the same color using paths with no more than two turns. Observe the board, think strategically, and find the best connections to clear each level. With increasingly challenging layouts and creative puzzles, every stage puts your logic and problem-solving skills to the test. Connect, match, and conquer every level to become the ultimate Puzzle Master!

title: Punch Through!
description: Framed for stealing the Mayors Golden Donut, prisoner #4027 punches his way out! Smash walls block by block in first person, vacuum the rubble, cash it in and upgrade from fists to boxing gloves, a hammer, a pickaxe, a drill, dynamite and a laser blaster. Explore 7 zones and 38 rooms from the prison to outer space, beat 7 bosses, follow Moe the Moles clues at trap forks, find 55 hidden treasures, hire mole helpers that dig while youre away and Escape for permanent perks.

title: Frosty Ball
description: Frosty Ball is a fast-paced physics platformer set across icy peaks and cosmic frost! Roll your way through challenging obstacles, collect golden coins, leap over sharp spikes, and unlock 10 adorable snowball characters. Each world brings exciting new mechanics like anti-gravity pads, portals, swinging frost maces, and deadly laser beams. Can you earn 3 stars on every stage?

title: Color Sort Party
description: Have fun with this super-addictive game. Get to work: pour liquids between tubes, sort the colors and beat increasingly challenging levels. Use special boosters, think strategically and keep moving forward.

title: Fish Tank: Caretaker Simulator
description: Step into Fish Tank: Caretaker Simulator, the ultimate aquatic management experience! Design vibrant underwater habitats, maintain precise water chemistry, and nourish a diverse range of marine life. Troubleshoot equipment, prevent disease, and expand your tanks to build a thriving, peaceful aquatic paradise

title: Emergency Rush: City Ambulance Rescue
description: Get ready to become a real-life hero in Emergency Rush: City Ambulance Rescue! Take control of a powerful ambulance and race through busy city streets to reach patients in urgent need of medical assistance. Your mission is to respond to emergency calls, navigate heavy traffic, avoid road obstacles, and transport patients safely to the hospital. Every second counts, so stay focused and use your driving skills to reach your destination as quickly and safely as possible. Explore exciting driving challenges, experience fast-paced ambulance missions, and test your ability to handle emergency situations on the road. Drive carefully through crowde

title: Fast Connect: One Line Blitz
description: One Line Blitz is a fast-paced one-line puzzle game that challenges your logic, speed, and precision. Draw a single continuous path from start to finish, fill every tile, and avoid forbidden blocks without crossing your own path. Race against the clock, solve increasingly challenging puzzles, earn higher scores with your remaining time, and climb the global leaderboard. Master every level and prove your skills in this addictive brain-training puzzle challenge!

title: Hilltop Hustle
description: Floor it up endless bumpy hills in a bouncy physics driving game! Balance your jeep over crests, grab fuel cans before the tank runs dry and pull off flips and big air for bonus coins, but never land on your head. Spend your coins on engine, suspension, tire and fuel upgrades, unlock a dirt bike, a tractor and a monster truck, and conquer meadows, desert dunes, icy peaks and the low-gravity moon. Chain flips, big air and wheelies into a x5 stunt multiplier, clear three goals every run and race a fresh daily track.

title: Lantern Wayfarner
description: The bell has fallen silent and a thick, creeping murk has swallowed the land. Only one traveler still carries a light. Grab your lantern, become the Lantern Wayfarer and bring the beacons back to life! Run, jump, wall-jump and dash across dangerous platforms. Spirit platforms only appear inside your lanterns glow, so use your light wisely. Hold the flare to scout the darkness ahead, push back gloom wisps and shadow creatures, and stomp your enemies. Light every beacon, find the waylamps to save your progress, and face the giant shadow beast Murkmaw at the end of each world.

title: Moto Extreme: Halloween Land
description: In this Halloween-themed 3D side-scrolling motorcycle game, an exciting riding experience awaits you on dark and mysterious tracks. Overcome challenging obstacles, keep your motorcycle balanced, and complete a variety of dangerous tracks. Carefully navigate through a world designed with a spooky atmosphere, use your riding skills, and try to reach the end of each track. Control your motorcycle, overcome the obstacles, and join the adventure in the eerie atmosphere of Halloween.

title: Halloween Hand Care
description: Welcome to Halloween Hand Care! Run a spooky clinic and help six friendly monster patients feel better. Treat swollen fingers, soothe red bumps, cover scratches and remove splinters. Flip the hand to discover more problems, use X-rays to find injuries and apply splints. Zoom in to clean all five fingernails, then decorate the healthy hand with colorful drawings! Enjoy vibrant cartoon artwork, cheerful Halloween music and satisfying treatment effects. Perfect for mouse and touch play.

title: Duckling Rush.io
description: Duckling Rush.io is a cute pond arcade where you play a mama duck racing to gather the longest line of ducklings. Swim around a big pond, scoop up lost ducklings, and steal them from rival mamas by cutting through their line. Dodge the hungry pike, use your QUACK burst to speed ahead and make rivals wobble, and finish each 90 second round with the longest conga line to win bread. Every duckling has a personality: sleepy, brown, punk, rubber and rare golden ones worth extra.

title: Draw Path To Finish
description: Help the heroine cross a course filled with dangerous obstacles. Draw a line that becomes the route for her moving platform, then watch whether she can make it to the finish. Saws, fire, lava, cannons, explosive barrels, and other traps stand in the way. Plan each route carefully, collect coins, and unlock new looks. Every level presents a different combination of hazards, so victory takes precision, planning, and a little courage.

title: Roadster Dash: Halloween Night
description: Roadster Dash: Halloween Night is a 3D arcade racing game with a flying car! Boost down a haunted highway, jump over traffic, fly, flip and barrel roll to chain stunt combos. Collect glowing pumpkins, grab power-ups and race under the full moon as ghosts and bats haunt four spooky zones. Play Solo for a high score or challenge a friend in 2 Player split-screen mode: same road, best of 3 rounds, and spooky hexes like fog, blackout and reversed controls to curse your rival!

title: Kick the Zombie: Ragdoll Sandbox
description: Kick the Zombie is a goofy ragdoll physics toy set in a moonlit graveyard. Meet Gus, a polite cartoon zombie who is happy to be dragged, flung, kicked and bonked. Grab him and throw him into bouncy headstones and walls, boot him with a giant sneaker, smack him with a frying pan, freeze him, zap him, blast him from a pumpkin cannon or tie balloons to him and watch him float away. His head pops off and hops right back, so it is all slapstick fun.

title: SnakeArea.io
description: In a world ruled by snakes, only the most skilled will survive. Every enemy is a test of your instincts. Devour without mercy, grow without limits and claim ultimate power. Unleash your hunger, conquer all 10 stages and prove that nothing can stand in your way.

title: Spotless
description: Spotless is a satisfying pressure-washing game! Clean 100 jobs, blast away mud, moss, rust and grime, chain combos, trigger Fever and earn coins. Upgrade your pump, unlock nozzles and tackle massive jobs, from stop signs to cargo ships and rockets. Can you beat the final Boss and Legendary contracts?

title: The Space Mover
description: The Space Mover is an exciting brain puzzle game that combines robot control, magnetic movement, and smart problem-solving challenges. Guide a clever robot through space-like levels, use magnetic power to move boxes, and place each target block into the correct position to complete missions. This challenging strategy adventure tests your timing and logic skills.

title: Rainbow Ball Runner 2048
description: Roll, dodge obstacles and collect matching balls as you race along a colorful water track. Grow your ball, stay on the path, and take on increasingly challenging levels! Web Dev https://www.pokii.com.es/

title: Sky Ace: Stunt Plane Islands
description: Take the controls of a bright stunt plane and fly free over palm islands, a red canyon, snowy peaks and a city at sunset. Thread glowing rings, pop balloons, chain loops and barrel rolls into huge combos, race rival pilots and land on a runway or the deck of a carrier. Earn stars and coins across 28 missions to unlock five planes with their own handling and eight paint jobs.

title: Halloween Tile Tumble
description: Play Halloween Block Collapse and clear spooky Halloween blocks in an addictive puzzle adventure filled with satisfying chain reactions. Match connected blocks, earn points, unleash powerful boosters, overcome tricky layouts, and reach target scores to unlock increasingly challenging levels.

title: Stand Modes and Cases   3D
description: Key Features: A true 3D duel mode where you can play with rare skins! • Opening cases — a wide selection of skin collections. • 3D graphics and detailed previews — examine each item from every angle. • Buy and sell items on the marketplace—filter, find, and purchase any skins. • Mini-games and a clicker—earn gold to open even more cases and get unique items. • Constant updates and new collections—there’s always something new to discover!

title: Sunfield Vegetable Farm
description: Grow, harvest and sell fresh vegetables in Sunfield, a cozy 3D farming game! Plant carrots, tomatoes and cabbages, water them and watch them grow. Stock the market carts, serve customers at the checkout and collect your money. Buy new land to expand your farm with more beds, fields and carts. Unlock corn, pumpkin, eggplant, potato, onion, pepper and watermelon. Hire a cashier and farm workers to help you. Mode: single player, endless farm progress. Characters: farmer, customers, cashier, farm workers. Saves automatically. Plays on desktop and mobile.

title: Clearfell: Forest Outpost
description: Clearfell: Forest Outpost is an isometric 3D base-building survival game. Start with one tent in a small clearing deep in an endless forest. Chop your way out, gather wood, stone, gold and iron, and build sawmills, mines, walls, turrets and mortars. The forest hides goblin camps, caged prisoners, ore veins and wandering merchants. Rescue settlers and put them to work. Every other night goblins raid your base along their trails. Fight back with guns and grenades, then follow the trails and burn their lairs - but new ones rise deeper in the woods. Day and night, weather, research, trophies and achievements. English and Russian.

title: Villadash Hero Rescue
description: Morvane and his bandits are raiding the villages of the kingdom, and every villager he carries off makes him stronger. You have one round to get to them first. Pick Ronan the knight, Lyra the rogue or Brann the frost druid and race through the village against the clock. Knock out the guards around each group of captives, hold to cut them free and send them running for the gate, while Morvane walks to the nearest group to drag it away. Every group you save is a point for you and more strength for the duel against him at the end of the round. The campaign has 7 villages, each with a new rule: archers across the river, villagers locked inside houses, recruits who fight at your side, houses on fire, a night convoy to the bonfires, and a final battle at Morvanes citadel where you switch between all three heroes. Heroes level up from 1 to 10 for stronger abilities. Earn stars, spend coins on training and outfits, and climb the local top 10 of each village.

title: Steal Car Duel
description: Step into a high-energy world of engines, rivalry, and fast reflexes. Steal Car Duel is a competitive action game that evolves the idea of Steal a Brainrot into a car-based experience filled with duels, rare collectibles, and endless upgrades! Race, collide, and steal your way to the top. Build your own garage, earn coins and tickets, and outsmart rivals to prove who rules the arena. Each match combines skill, timing, and strategy as you fight for dominance in Solo or 2 Player mode.

title: Cadillacs: Dino Riot
description: Choose Kira or Bo and fight to stop a dinosaur-smuggling convoy in a colourful 2D rescue adventure. Eight chapters lead through multiple combat zones, dusty roads and dangerous compounds. Chain punches, jump, grab and throw enemies, use found weapons and free caged dinosaurs. Web Dev https://www.crazygamesx.com/ Rescued animals can turn a fight in your favour. Checkpoints, illustrated scenery and an original funky soundtrack keep the adventure moving on desktop or mobile.

title: Simulator GT Motorsport
description: Drive GT Motorsport-style cars in your browser. Pick cars, upgrade, build your skill tree, then take on Circuit, Short Race, Drag Race, and Drift.

title: Midway Malarkey
description: Midway Malarkey is a hand-painted 1930s cartoon arena brawler. Rascals pour out of every tent at the carnival and your weapons fire on their own: rolling pins, trumpets, tesla coils and falling anvils. Dodge their shots, grab tickets, spend them in the Prize Booth between waves, merge weapons into stronger ones and collect weapon families for bonuses. Modes: the Endless Show (survive as long as you can while the nightmare scaling keeps rising), the 15-wave Grand Tour campaign, and a new Daily Show every day with its own twist (30 different shows). Characters: six heroes to unlock - Blot, Tilly, Gramps, Penny, Spool and Bix - each with their own starting weapon. Bosses: the strongman, Madame Merry-Go-Round and Barnaby Hokum, the Ringmaster. Plus carnival attractions like the Prize Wheel and the Strongman Bell, and four swing-era songs.

title: Block Drop Escape Puzzle
description: Block Drop Escape Puzzle is a colorful puzzle game about choosing the right blocks in the right order. Tap a piece to release its blocks, fill matching colored boxes, and clear the board. Plan ahead and keep the limited holding space from filling up across 71 levels. Play with a mouse or touch. Progress is saved in your current browser.

title: Mud Truck Simulator Game
description: Get ready for an exciting offroad driving adventure with Mud Truck Simulator Game! Take control of powerful trucks, drive through muddy roads, explore challenging offroad environments, and test your driving skills across rough terrain. Experience the thrill of truck driving as you navigate difficult routes and enjoy an immersive truck simulation adventure.

title: SPOOKY BOXING
description: Enter the haunted ring in Spooky Boxing! Choose from 12 monsters with unique abilities, battle through spooky arenas and unlock each fighter’s comic ending. Throw jabs, crosses and charged uppercuts while guarding and dodging enemy attacks.

title: Breach Ops
description: Breach Ops is a tactical first-person shooter against smart bots. In Bomb Defusal, Raiders plant the bomb and Wardens defend and defuse it in 5v5 rounds with a buy menu and round economy. Arena is a Quake-style free-for-all with power-ups, jump pads and bunny hopping. Fight on 3 maps, Sandstone, Depot and Polar Station, with 9 guns, a knife, grenades and armor. Climb 13 ranks, upgrade 8 skills, open cases for 44 weapon skins and collect 52 agents. Choose the bot difficulty or let it grow with your rank.

title: Void Rescue
description: Void Rescue is a retro pixel-art rescue game set in glowing crystal caves on an alien planet. Pilot your rescue capsule through narrow tunnels, find stranded survivors and carry them back to base before your fuel runs out. Watch out for turrets and patrol drones guarding the caves. Every level is harder than the last, so land carefully, manage your fuel and see how far you can get. Earn a place on your personal top 5 by level reached and fastest time.

title: RECOILS
description: One button. Endless chaos. Youre a gun hanging from a parachute, and the only way to move is to shoot. Every shot kicks you back, so you blast robots and steer at the same time. Easy to learn, hard to put down. - Simple to play: tap or click to shoot. Time your shots and chain kills into huge combos. - Ride the kick: aim down to fly up, bounce bullets off the edge and dodge incoming fire. - Giant bosses: every 300 m a boss stomps in. Shoot off its armor and hit the core. - Collect 44 skins: open Skin Crates and find rare, epic, legendary and MYTHIC skins that light up your bullets and explosions. - Something new every day: daily rewards, fr

title: Save My Human
description: Step into the paws of a hero cat! Navigate tile by tile through tricky puzzles and dangerous paths to rescue your beloved human. Can you save your favorite owner? It’s up to you, a brave little cat, to rescue your human! There are 50 Levels and a short Story Mode.

title: Anime Mom: Family Life Simulator
description: Step into the daily life of an anime mom and experience a fun family life simulator! Take care of your home, complete simple tasks, manage daily activities, and keep your family happy. Explore colorful environments, complete different challenges, and enjoy relaxing family moments in this entertaining anime-style simulation game. Every task brings something new to do as you balance home activities and family responsibilities. Can you become the best anime mom and handle everything your busy day throws at you? Features: Anime-style characters and colorful environments Fun family life simulation gameplay Simple tasks and interactive activiti

title: Sniper Hero: Urban Strike
description: Take aim, line up each shot and clear a series of urban missions. Watch your targets carefully, avoid civilians, and manage your limited ammunition—every shot counts. Complete each stage to move forward and prove your precision.

title: Ligmar Online
description: Ligmar Online brings together what we loved about old-school browser MMORPGs: leveling, rare loot, dungeons, and PvP. There’s always someone to beat or a piece of gear worth chasing. But it’s the people that make it stick. You find your regular group, get to know your rivals, and fight for territory with your guild. And when something good drops, guild chat hears about it first. All with vibrant graphics, right in your browser. No client to download. Just open the game, and you’re in.

title: Splash Rivals
description: Splash Rivals is an online multiplayer paint shooter where two teams of four battle to cover the arena in their colour. Spray the ground, splash your rivals and swim through your teams paint to refill your paint tank and recover health. Choose from seven weapons, customise your character and powers, and team up with friends or create private matches for up to eight players!

title: Bus Simulator Game 2026
description: Welcome to the Bus Simulator Game 2026. This is a fun and exciting game where you drive a big bus on rough and bumpy roads in mud bus game. If you enjoy driving games and want to try something new, this game is just right for you. . Each level is full of fun, adventure, and new challenges. You will drive your bus through hills, dirt roads, and rocky paths. The roads are not smooth, so you need to drive carefully to avoid falling or crashing. You have to be careful and avoid hitting them while driving your bus. This makes the game even more exciting and fun.

title: Paint & Escape
description: Paint & Escape is a neon stealth-action game. Sneak past the guards, paint your graffiti masterpiece on the glowing spot, then escape before they catch you! Every level is a newly built house, school, museum or arcade, and the guards get smarter as you go. Watch out for security cameras, guard dogs and armored guards. Splat guards with paint bombs, taunt them with dances and collect spray cans for 3 stars. Unlock upgrades, outfits and hats, and come back for daily gifts, quests and trophies.

title: Midnight Valet
description: Midnight Valet is a 3D valet parking simulator. Your night shift at the citys busiest club runs from 22:00 to 04:00. Take the keys from arriving guests, park their cars in the lot, hang the keys on the key board, then find the right key and bring each car back to the door when the guest comes out. Regular guests wait patiently. Hasty guests carry a countdown timer. Tipsy guests say the wrong key number, so find their car by its colour. The mafia boss wants his black-gold sports car in the VIP spot only, and scratches bring threats.

title: Nitro Racing Gear
description: Hit the road in Nitro Racing Gear, a high-speed arcade racing game! Take on 40 stages across eight worlds, from coastal highways and neon cities to snowy mountains and volcanic roads. Compete in races, sprints, drift challenges, and drag duels. Unlock cars, upgrade their performance in the garage, and unleash nitro boosts to chase victory. Enjoy realistic 3D-rendered artwork, distinctive tracks, and an energetic soundtrack as you work toward the final championship.

title: Trick Or Treat Candy Carnival
description: Visit a moonlit Halloween carnival with Count Boo and his monster friends. Choose from seven games: pop ghosts, build 24 jigsaw pictures, find matching pairs, explore a talking alphabet, catch falling candy, recognize shadows and clear groups of monster faces. Pick gentle play or a challenge, collect candy, unlock four baskets and fill your collection of 24 cartoon friends. Puzzles offer 4, 9, 16 or 25 interlocking pieces.

title: Magline Moto
description: Magline Moto is a futuristic stunt bike racer. Ride a hyperbike on glowing energy-ring wheels across 30 hand-built levels in 3 worlds: Neon District, Emberfall and Cryo Spire. Flip in the air for time bonuses, blast drones, aliens, mines, barrels and laser gates with your front laser, and burn nitro to clear huge gaps. Survive boss chases against the Forge Matriarch and the Cryo Sentinel, earn cash and unlock 12 bikes with unique perks.

title: Road Restore
description: Road Restore is a 3D game about fixing roads, one stretch at a time. Drive your truck over damaged asphalt, repaint road markings, and install guardrails across 70 sectors, from quiet forests to coastal roads and mountain passes. Your tools work automatically as you drive. When supplies run low, head back to the depot for a free refill. Use the money you earn to improve your truck, unlock better equipment, and pick up new skins along the way. Move on when the next sector opens, or stay a little longer to finish every job and earn all three stars. You can return to earlier sectors with your upgraded truck or take on repeatable contracts. title: Rubber Doodle
description: Rubber Doodle is a physics puzzle where every line you draw turns into a rubber band. Draw a band, stretch it and let it snap: catch the ball, fling it like a slingshot, wrap bands around pegs and bounce off walls. Guide the ball into the cup through 75 hand-drawn stages and 3 tutorials, with saws, lasers, TNT, portals, keys, boost arrows, upside-down gravity and long-shot baskets. Earn stars, unlock new worlds and discover your own solutions.

title: Zombie Barrage
description: Zombie Barrage is a top-down zombie defense game. Hold the barricade against increasingly dangerous waves, defeat mutated bosses, earn coins, and upgrade your weapons and gear between rounds. Aim carefully, manage your ammunition, and protect the barricade as the attacks grow stronger. Play directly in your browser on desktop or mobile.

title: I Get You
description: I Get You is a troll platformer where the level itself is your opponent. It has eyes, it talks, and every trap is something its body does: the floor yawns under your feet, the ground gets goosebumps, it sneezes you off a ledge, and doors turn into teeth. Every death teaches you its next trick. Beat a level and it gets deleted forever. 40 levels across two corridors, and the deleted ones come back. They’re mad. Short levels, instant respawn, and a death counter that never forgets.

title: Speed Evolution
description: Race down an 11-stage sky track where every metre makes you faster. Level up and watch your ride evolve from a skateboard into a shopping cart, a monster truck, a shark car and a space racer while you jump spikes and dodge saws, spinners, lasers and lava. Rebirth for bigger multipliers and unlock the desert and the stars.

title: Pixel Protocol
description: Pixel Protocol is a fast low-poly team arena shooter in your browser. Pick a map, set the difficulty and the number of allies and enemies, then fight bots in quick 4v4 matches. Choose between three blasters, dash and use your shield to stay alive. Three arenas: Container Yard, Blackwood Depot and Skybridge. Earn credits, level up, complete daily challenges and unlock free cosmetic items in the store.

title: police car chaser
description: **Police Car Chase** Get ready for an exciting high-speed police chase! Drive your police car through busy roads, chase down criminals, and test your driving skills in thrilling missions. Avoid obstacles, steer carefully, and keep chasing your targets to become the ultimate police driver. Can you catch the criminals and complete every chase? title: 100 Doors: Mystery Room Escape
description: Step into the world of mystery and test your brain in 100 Doors: Mystery Room Escape! Can you crack the secret codes, solve tricky logic puzzles, find hidden objects, and unlock all 100 doors to escape each room? Every room presents a unique mind-bending challenge featuring intricate mechanical gears, hidden keys, cryptic symbols, and secret keypad codes. Game Features: • 100+ Challenging and fun escape room levels • Intuitive puzzle-solving mechanics and riddles • Beautiful 3D room environments and immersive sound effects • Fun for puzzle lovers of all ages • Auto-save progress — continue your escape anytime! Think outside the box, find

title: Float for Brainrots
description: Float for Brainrots is a chaotic water adventure game where you collect rare Brainrots across dangerous seas. Start with a simple raft, unlock powerful boats, upgrade speed and capacity, and explore deeper waters for better rewards. Manage your timer, avoid sharks, and use islands to survive. Play solo or with a friend in 2 player mode and build your ultimate Brainrot collection.

title: Escape School Duel
description: Escape School Duel is a fast, funny, and tense escape challenge set inside a school that does not want to let you leave. Play solo to chase your best time, or go 2 player and turn every hallway into a race for freedom. One moment you are dodging traps, the next you are trying to slip past the principal in a long corridor or outsmart a teacher waiting near the classroom. Every section has its own danger, so learning the school layout is part of the strategy.

title: Rocket Car Football Championship
description: Rocket-powered cars meet football in the floodlit Breymantech Arena! Boost, jump, flip and fly to smash a giant ball into the opponent’s goal in fast 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 matches against smart AI teams that rotate, defend, save shots and even go for aerials. Fight your way through the Championship: five cups from Bronze to Champions. Each cup has 8 teams, a group stage with league tables, then semi-finals and a final with golden-goal overtime. Win cups to unlock legendary cars like Titan and Legend. Build your dream car in the Garage. Pick from 8 cars with their own body styles and stats, 9 paint jobs, and 8 upgrades with 10 levels each

title: CORE RUSH
description: CORE RUSH is a 3D sliding puzzle adventure. Launch your rover through 48 rooms, collect every core and reach the exit. Break crates, trigger chain reactions, unlock gates and master portals. Plan efficient routes to earn three stars, discover relics and unlock new rover looks. Free hints and undo help you try again.

title: Narcos: Crime Master
description: Step into the role of an aspiring crime boss in a colorful low-poly city. Drive through the streets, take on rival crews, and work through missions that mix car chases, street fights, and risky deals. Build your reputation as you rise through the city’s underworld. Web Dev https://www.kizi10.org/

title: TRICK PAWS
description: Trick Paws: Trap Run is a funny troll platformer where nothing is what it looks like! Guide a brave little cat through 100 tricky levels full of hidden spikes, crumbling floors, falling rocks, rolling traps and fake platforms that will surprise you when you least expect it. Run, jump and double jump across 4 worlds - Rookie, Explorer, Hero and Legend - and blast enemies with your cats blaster or stomp them from above. Zombies, bats and 15 kinds of enemies stand in your way, and every 5th level ends with a big boss fight. Collect gold coins quickly to build combo multipliers, grab every shiny gem and reach the yellow flag with zero fails to

title: SIX FOLD
description: SIXFOLD: a 3D snake in six panels. Steer one ink line over a paper cube. Every mark you eat adds a link and the line moves faster; cross an edge and the cube rolls, turning the panel under you into a wall. Six faces, no floor, no finish — only your own line can stop you, so bite yourself and the run ends. SCORE is links eaten, BEST is your record. Three start paces: CALM, BRISK, FERAL. Arrows or WASD on desktop, swipe on touch.

title: Jelly Mob Rush
description: Lead a wobbly mob of jelly people down a candy lane and pick the gates that grow your crowd. Squeeze past pizza cutters and sweepers, beat the red jelly army, then climb the macaron staircase for a coin multiplier. Four candy worlds, four jelly king bosses, upgrades, jelly skins and hats.

title: Shooter: Soldiers vs Zombies
description: Shooter: Soldiers vs Zombies is a free online first-person shooter where you fight alongside AI soldiers against zombie hordes. Explore six maps, including Italy, Train, and Inferno, in timed team deathmatch battles. Buy weapons ranging from pistols and assault rifles to sniper rifles and grenade launchers. Aim carefully, manage your ammunition, and help your squad outscore the zombies. Play this 3D zombie shooting game directly in your browser on desktop or mobile.

title: Last Shift
description: Last Shift: Humans vs Machines is a fast 3D top-down action game. Technology is slowly taking over and five ordinary workers fight back. CHARACTERS: Programmer (homing code bolts), Soldier (rapid-fire rifle), Financier (bouncing coins, extra gold), Cleaner (slowing soap spray) and Garbage Collector (heavy piercing trash bags). LEVELS: 5 chapters with 10 rooms each - Smart City (robots and drones), Server Farm, Global Warming, The Parliament (devil-horned politicians) and The Singularity. Every chapter ends with a boss: The Supercomputer, AI Overlord, Carbon Colossus, The Chancellor and The Singularity. Dodge enemy fire, stand still to attack automatically and pick a new ability on every level-up: Twin Shot, Ricochet, Chain Lightning, Orbital Strike, Plasma Orbs, Force Field and more. MODES: Campaign, Survival, Crypto Heist, Boss Rush, Skyscraper (endless floors) and Server Maze. Upgrade gear, unlock heroes and talents, and complete daily quests.

title: SIDEFIRE
description: SIDEFIRE is a tactical 2D side-view team shooter. Jump into fast 5v5 Team Deathmatch against smart bots on Plant 7, a multi-level factory map with catwalks, containers and scaffolding. First team to 40 kills - or the leader after 5 minutes - wins. Choose from 9 realistic weapons, including the AK-74, M4A1, MP5, SVD, M870 and PKM, and tune them with optics, muzzles, underbarrel gear and magazines. Throw grenades, land headshots, chain killstreaks and level up to unlock new guns and attachments. Open cases for weapon skins and operator gear, claim daily rewards and pick easy, normal or hard bots.

title: Arctic Truck Driver
description: Arctic Truck Driver is a realistic 3D ice road trucking game. Haul cargo across frozen lakes where the ice decides how fast you can go. Thick ice is safe, but dark ice with glowing cracks is thin – drive too fast and it breaks under your truck. Choose jobs from the job board: mining supplies, a fuel tanker that sloshes when you brake, long pipe bundles, sensitive explosives, or rescue missions where you tow a stranded pickup to camp. Drive in convoys and keep your distance, steer around open water, slow down for pressure ridges and watch the ice stress meter.

title: BoomBitz:Bomb Chips
description: **BoomBitz: Bomb Chips** Get ready for an explosive puzzle adventure in BoomBitz: Bomb Chips! Match colorful chips, trigger exciting bomb blasts, and clear the board through fun and challenging levels. Combine matching pieces to create powerful explosions, chain reactions, and satisfying combos. Plan your moves carefully, discover special power-ups, and use smart strategies to clear tricky layouts. Each level brings new challenges that test your logic, timing, and puzzle-solving skills. Enjoy colorful graphics, smooth gameplay, exciting effects, and easy-to-learn controls. Can you clear every board and become the ultimate BoomBitz champion

title: MISREGISTER
description: MISREGISTER: a four-page seam proof pressed on one cuboid. Ink lands on the page facing you, but after every shot the press turns to a page you did not pick and the ink keeps pressing down on all four. Three or more of one ink pop, even across pages, and anything left hanging falls. Drift adds a row to all four pages on a timer; one bubble over the trim rail spoils the edition. A pop scores 10, a fall 15, and 25 for each extra page one pop crossed. Drag to aim on desktop and phones.

title: Neon Circuit Rush
description: Quick Race Car is a 3D arcade racing game with three ways to play. Pick a car, hit the track, steer through the race and earn coins to explore the shop. Use the keyboard or on-screen controls, and enjoy fast-paced driving with mouse or touch support. Web Dev https://www.gamess.com.es/

title: Brainrot Mega Parkour
description: Step into the wildest parkour adventure yet. Brainrot Mega Parkour brings together four intense modes, forty handcrafted levels, and a cast of hilarious characters in a single high-speed package. Whether you’re climbing an endless tower, racing across a platform full of traps, escaping a rolling lava ball, or surviving a lava flood, every level pushes your reflexes and timing to the limit.

title: Gun Trigger
description: Gun Trigger is an action-packed shooter where you play as a stylish agent. Flip through dynamic levels in slow motion and eliminate enemies with perfect timing

title: Contra: Jungle Breach
description: Join Mara on a fast 2D run-and-gun rescue mission through ten areas, from jungle outposts to frozen facilities and an alien lair. Aim while moving, jump over incoming shots and use a dash to escape tight situations. Find weapon upgrades, activate relays and face escalating enemy encounters. Web Dev https://www.pokiplay.com.es/ Choose your difficulty, return to checkpoints and enjoy a punchy original arcade soundtrack. Play using keyboard and mouse or mobile touch controls.

title: Animals Brick
description: **AnimalBrick** is a fun and addictive tile-matching puzzle game where you match three identical animal tiles to clear the board. Complete each level’s objective, plan your moves carefully, and avoid filling all seven tile slots without making a match. With colorful animations, increasingly challenging levels, and strategic match-3 gameplay, AnimalBrick is perfect for puzzle fans of all ages!

title: City Taxi Driving
description: # Taxi Car Driving **Drive Through the City. Pick Up Passengers. Become a Taxi Driving Expert!** Get behind the wheel and experience the excitement of city driving in Taxi Car Driving! Drive through busy streets, pick up passengers, reach their destinations, and explore a lively city filled with roads, traffic, and exciting driving challenges. Whether you enjoy realistic driving experiences, casual car games, or passenger transport simulators, Taxi Car Driving offers an entertaining journey where your driving skills make every trip count. ## Become a Professional Taxi Driver Start your journey as a taxi driver and take passengers a

title: SatisPuzzle Perfect Tidy
description: SatisPuzzle Perfect Tidy is a multi-theme brain puzzle game packed with casual mini-games. From sorting and delivery tasks to cooking, problem-solving, and spooky searches, every level brings a fresh little challenge to enjoy. Fans of tidy-up gameplay can enjoy ASMR cleaning games, where clicking, dragging, sorting, and organizing gradually turn messy scenes into neat and satisfying spaces. There is also plenty of fun for those who love cooking.

title: Formula Car Race
description: Get ready for an exciting racing experience in Formula Car Race! Drive your formula car, control your speed, and race your way toward victory. Test your driving skills, master the turns, and enjoy fast-paced car racing action. Can you become the ultimate racing champion? Start your engine and hit the track!

title: Poppy Playtime: Impostor Hunt
description: Become the ultimate imposter! In Poppy Playtime: Impostor Hunt, play as iconic toy monsters, sneak up on unsuspecting crewmates, and eliminate them with a bat. Stay hidden, strike fast, and execute stealthy kills before they spot you and vote you off! Web Dev https://www.gamesfree.org.es/

title: Crumple Rumble
description: Crumple Rumble is a fast, funny stickman fighting game scribbled on notebook paper. Pick one of five doodle fighters, chain punches and kicks into combos, grab pencils, staffs and pipes, and charge your power bar to fire a special move. When your rival is dizzy, the announcer shouts Wrap it up! and your last hit decides how they go: flattened, folded into a paper plane, inflated like a balloon, erased, and eight more silly endings. Climb the Arcade ladder of four rivals and a final boss, take on a new Daily Challenge with its own twist every day, survive as long as you can in endless Survival, or share one keyboard or touch screen with a friend in 2 Players mode. Daily missions, a rank ladder and ten unlockable ink colours for your fighter give you a reason to come back. Four paper arenas each change the rules, and a floating switch flips any of them to dark mode with low gravity.

title: Mask of six Moons
description: Mask of Six Moons is a pixel-art action platformer. Dive through the moon gates, battle monsters and loot weapons from Common all the way to the ultra-rare Phantom tier. Choose from 12 weapon types, including greatswords, scythes, hammers, bows, staffs and chain whips, each with its own moves. Every weapon rolls random bonuses, and rare ones carry unique effects. Level up, spend points on five stats and unlock dash, double jump and wall jump. Two gates are open now: the Sunken Crypt, guarded by the Drowned Carillon, and the Fungal Caverns, ruled by the Mother Bloom. More gates are coming in future updates.

title: Haunted Panic
description: Guard twelve haunted doors in Haunted Panic. Tap monsters before they strike, spare friendly ghosts and hammer bonus chests for gold. Travel through six Halloween worlds across 24 nights, unleash pumpkin blasts and face the Night Lords. Earn stars, unlock relics and improve your Arcade powers, or try Classic mode with one life.

title: Rope Chef
description: Rope Chef is a cute physics puzzle about cooking. Ingredients hang on ropes above a pot. Cut the ropes at the right moment so each one swings, bounces or floats into the pot in the order the recipe card shows. Get the order right and the dish is served. Miss, or drop the wrong one first, and Nibbs the steamed-bun chef swoons dramatically. 50 short levels across 14 cuisines: Singapore hawker, Japan, Italy, Mexico, India, Korea, France, USA, Thailand, Middle East, China, Vietnam, Spain and Peru. Every world adds a twist: bounce pads, bubbles you pop, fans, a moving pot, a hot pan, portals, conveyor belts, flippers, wind, a rival chefs decoy pot, burning ropes and slippery ice. Earn up to 3 stars per dish: serve it, grab the spice, beat par time. Unlock worlds with stars, keep a daily streak, use the ghost line to preview a swing, and skip a dish you are stuck on. Nibbs cheers, winks, sneezes and juggles along the way. Works on desktop and mobile.

title: Sink Hole
description: Become a hungry sinkhole! Swallow a city, grow bigger, devour rivals and destroy skyscrapers! Features: 4 game modes: Classic, Battle Royale, Solo Rush and Wipeout. Eat smaller rivals and avoid bigger ones. Chain x5 combos and grab powerful boosts. Realistic 3D city with collapsing buildings. Unlock skins, complete missions and earn rewards. Track your stats and beat your records. Eat. Grow. Destroy. Dominate the city!

title: Island Mayhem: Tiki Blast 3D
description: Island Mayhem is a colorful 3D cannon shooting and physics puzzle game. Join Bonko, a brave little pirate monkey, and blast your way across tropical islands! Aim the cannon, set the power and fire to knock down tiki towers, wooden forts and stone walls. Every block, barrel and tiki moves with real physics, so one smart shot can bring the whole tower crashing down. Play 200 levels across 10 islands, from Tropical Isles and Volcanic Reef to Frosty Cove and Thunder Peaks, each with new twists like slippery ice, moving platforms, wind and low gravity. Defeat a giant tiki boss at the end of every island. Use 10 special cannonballs such as Blas

title: Citadel: Fortress Defense
description: Citadel: Fortress Defense is a 3D medieval strategy game in first person. Each day you build your town, then a raid comes. Build walls, gates, houses, farms, sawmills, quarries, towers, barracks, a market and a mage tower. Gather wood, stone, gold and food. Characters: you are the Lord. Hire knights, archers and mages and control any soldier in battle. Enemies: goblins, bandits, skeletons, shamans and enemy soldiers break through walls; every fifth day a boss arrives. Each raid is stronger: spend renown on upgrades, raise stone walls and expand your land. Mode: single player endless survival. If the town hall falls, the game is over.

title: Obby Rainbow Tower
description: Obby Rainbow Tower is a fast, winter-themed tower race where every second and every jump matters. Each floor is packed with moving platforms, icy tiles, spinning lava bars, surprise snowstorms and snowball portals that try to knock you into the void. You can replay the tower as many times as you like, trying to beat your own best time or racing a friend side by side in 2 player mode.

title: Obby Toilet Line
description: Obby Toilet Line starts in the most chaotic place imaginable: a gas station restroom line. Around 30 different characters are already waiting, and the queue stretches all the way past the store entrance. Your goal is simple, but the situation is not: earn money while you wait, move up the line, and reach the mysterious toilet at the end. This is not just a “stand still” queue. The game uses an idle-style progression system: the position you’re standing in determines how much you earn.

title: DarkHood
description: Step into a world where the only light is your own aura. Guide a brave boy in a dark hoodie through candle-lit caves, sleeping monsters and hidden passages. Collect every glowing gem, avoid bombs, pits and traps, and unlock the exit gate of each level. A cozy dark platform adventure designed for short relaxing sessions at home or on the go.

title: Tiny Track Rally
description: Race tiny toy cars in this colourful 3D arcade racer! Drift through corners, grab pickups, fire your nitro on the straights and beat up to 7 rival drivers to the finish line. Features: - 10 tracks in 2 cups. Cup 2 is bigger and harder, with crates, barrels, cones, narrow walls and moving barriers - Rain, fog, sunset and night races with headlights - 5 modes: Race, Time Trial, Elimination, Checkpoint and Daily Challenge - 6 camera views, from close chase to top-down - Garage: unlock cars and a bike, pick from 8 paint colours, and upgrade speed, acceleration, handling and drift - Coins, nitro refills and boost pads on the track

title: Funny Cars Reload
description: Funny Cars Reload – Cartoon Racing Adventure Get ready for a fun and exciting racing adventure! Drive crazy cartoon cars, race through challenging tracks, and test your driving skills in Funny Cars Reload. Explore multiple levels, overcome obstacles, improve your performance, and take on increasing challenges as you progress. Every race is a new opportunity to prove that you are the ultimate racing champion! Features: - Colorful 3D cartoon graphics. - Multiple levels and increasing difficulty. - Exciting racing challenges and obstacles. - Fun cars and fast-paced gameplay. - Playable directly in your browser. Can you master every level?

title: Boo Chains
description: Link cute Halloween monsters with the same number or one apart and watch them blow up! Long chains create pumpkin bombs, lightning and a wild ghost that explode together for huge combos. Travel across a spooky map with 5 zones, free monsters trapped in webs, chains, tombstones and armor, and beat a giant boss every 10 stages. Unlock 5 monster heroes with special powers, buy upgrades, complete daily missions and grab your nightly gift. Can you survive the whole night?

title: Monster Café: Idle Tycoon
description: Run the cosiest café at the edge of the haunted woods! Slimes, ghosts, vampires and zombies line up for bat lattes and pumpkin muffins. Tap their orders, collect coins and tips, upgrade spooky machines, hire monster waiters who serve even while youre away, and open five hand-drawn places: Crooked Café, Graveyard Terrace, Witchs Greenhouse, Castle Crypt and Sunken Shipwreck. 20 monsters with cute pets, 20 machines up to golden level 100, a 60-sticker album with rare golden guests, 28 trophies, daily treats and tasks, lucky bats and a Full Moon Move prestige with a Moon Shop. No timers that punish you, nothing to lose: just a warm, funny, always-growing café.

title: Netherton Volleyball
description: Tap on green, spike over the block, win the cup! Netherton Volleyball is a quick pixel-art volleyball game where you call the shots for a whole 6v6 team. Time your taps to serve, pass, dig and block, then pick your hitter: each rings color shows the chance to score. Your players level up after every match and learn new moves, from quick sets and pipes to jump serves and diving saves. Beat 18 rival teams, each with its own style, and lift the cup in a best-of-five final. Short matches, real volleyball rules, and the first match teaches you as you play. Game features: - Campaign: an 18-team ladder, best-of-three matches to 11 points, a best-of-

title: Sort Master   Satisfeel ASMR
description: Sort Master - Satisfeel ASMR is a relaxing puzzle game that combines item organization, satisfying sorting tasks, and calming ASMR moments. Arrange delicious foods, cabinets, and different objects into the correct places while enjoying a peaceful Satisfeel ASMR game experience. With simple drag-and-drop controls and relaxing gameplay, this creative sort game brings a satisfying feeling as every object finds its perfect position. Featuring various Mini-games and clever organizing challenges, the game helps you enjoy a stress-free break.

title: Warehouse Tetris 3D
description: Warehouse Tetris 3D is a relaxing 3D packing puzzle where you load boxes, crates, barrels, and cargo into warehouses, trucks, and shipping containers. Rotate pieces, plan every move, avoid empty gaps, and try to achieve the highest packing efficiency. Complete dozens of levels, earn stars, master special orders, and challenge yourself in Endless and Time Attack modes.

title: Bow or Die
description: Test your archery reflexes in Bow or Die, a fast-paced physics survival action game! Step into the arena as a master archer where precision and split-second reaction are your only lifeline. Aim your bow, calculate arrow trajectories, and eliminate incoming targets before they strike. Every shot counts—dodge lethal hazards, react swiftly under pressure, and battle for the ultimate high score. Can you hit your mark, or will you fall?

title: Glimmer
description: Guide a tiny spark through a world swallowed by darkness. Master precise jumps, dashes and checkpoints as you relight lanterns and conquer challenging handcrafted stages. Travel across four themed chapters, learn new movement challenges and discover the secret behind the final Sun Lantern. Fast restarts and checkpoints keep the adventure moving.

title: Shaftbound
description: Descend through perilous underground shafts in Shaftbound, a precision platform adventure built around skillful jumps and a versatile grappling hook. Swing through hazards, master your momentum, collect useful rewards and reach checkpoints across 36 handcrafted stages. The deeper you travel, the more demanding the obstacles become.

title: Formula Car Stunt
description: Get ready for an adrenaline-filled adventure in Formula Car Stunt Game! Drive powerful formula racing cars across thrilling sky-high tracks, perform spectacular stunts, and master challenging roads above the clouds. Explore 5 exciting game modes, including Stunt Mode, Police Chase, and Zigzag Mode, each offering unique challenges and high-speed action. Navigate sharp turns, race through daring tracks, escape police pursuits, and test your driving skills on impossible roads. Are you ready to conquer every track and become the ultimate stunt driver?

title: PocketGolf
description: A minimalist golf challenge drawn in a hand-made paper style. Flick the tiny paper ball across doodle fairways, bounce off pencils and erasers, and sink the hole in as few strokes as possible. Easy to pick up, tricky to master — unlock new balls and beat your own best score in bite-sized sessions.

title: Skibidi Vent Jumper
description: Skibidi Vent Jumper is a chaotic, stealthy creature lurking in bathroom air ducts. It springs out from hidden vents when least expected, surprising unsuspecting targets before flushing out of sight. Fast, unpredictable, and always suspicious, it turns any ordinary restroom into an intense game of survival. Web Dev https://www.driftboss.com.es/

title: Ragdoll Survivor
description: A stick fighter is stuck in the middle of a war zone and has to fight to stay alive. Punch, kick, block, dash and grab your way past enemy soldiers, knife fighters, riot shields and tanks, while bombs, rockets, saw blades and lava fall from the sky. Play 100 missions across 10 chapters, each ending with a boss fight. Fill the SUPER bar to go into RAGE mode. Earn coins to unlock new fighters and gear, and try Boss Rush, Endless and daily missions. Plays on computer, phone and gamepad.

title: DADDY MOUSE
description: Help a brave mouse collect cheese and return home to his family in this colorful 2D platform adventure. Explore forests, icy mountains, volcanic lands, the open sea, and dangerous castles. Jump over traps, discover hidden paths, collect golden stars, and defeat powerful bosses. Play with a keyboard on desktop or on-screen touch controls on mobile.

title: Slingshot Shooting Game
description: Get ready for an exciting slingshot shooting adventure! Slingshot Shooting Game is a fun and challenging casual game where your aim, timing, and shooting skills are put to the test. Pull back the slingshot, adjust your angle, release at the perfect moment, and hit your targets with precision. Take control of the slingshot and carefully plan every shot. Each level brings new challenges and requires you to improve your accuracy and strategy. Try to hit targets, destroy obstacles, and complete objectives using as few shots as possible.

title: Thief Puzzle Long Hand Game
description: Thief Puzzle Long Hand Game is a fun and challenging puzzle game where you control a thief with an incredibly long and flexible hand. Your mission is to carefully reach, grab, and steal the target objects while avoiding traps, obstacles, guards, and other dangers.

title: Barbee Fashion Influencer
description: Barbee Fashion Influencer is a fun and stylish dress-up game where fashion, creativity, and social-media-inspired trends come together. Help Barbee build the perfect influencer wardrobe by creating fashionable outfits that are ready for photoshoots, events, and stylish everyday moments.

title: Euro Truck Parking
description: Euro Truck Parking is an exciting truck-driving and parking simulation game where players take control of powerful heavy-duty trucks and put their driving skills to the test. Navigate challenging parking areas, tight spaces, busy roads, and realistic environments while carefully positioning your truck into designated parking zones. Master precise steering, reversing, braking, and trailer control as each level introduces new challenges. Avoid obstacles, follow road markings, and park accurately to earn higher scores and unlock new trucks, levels, and upgrades.

title: Skyblock 3D
description: Are you ready to survive on a small island floating high in the sky? Start your adventure with limited resources, collect blocks, create new areas, and gradually expand your island. Use your resources wisely, discover different materials, and build your own world. As you progress, unlock new opportunities, improve your island, and transform it into a massive floating home. An exciting adventure combining survival, exploration, and building awaits you!

title: Screw Nuts Snap Puzzle
description: Screw Nuts Snap Puzzle is a colorful puzzle game about matching screws and choosing the right order. Remove accessible screws from layered glass shapes and collect them in boxes of the same color. Each box holds three screws, while spare slots give you room to plan your next move. Clear the layers without filling the spare slots. Explore Unscrew mode and unlock challenges and cat-rescue puzzles as you progress. Use extra slots, box swaps, and a hammer to help with tricky boards. Play with a mouse or touch controls. Progress is saved in the current browser.

title: Left Dead: Last Convoy
description: Help medic Tess keep Omar and the convoy alive across 23 stages in five campaign routes. Fight through city streets, carnival grounds, bayou paths, a storm and the final bridge. Aim your rifle, reload between threats, shove infected away and use medical supplies wisely. Rescue survivors and secure fuel while checkpoints preserve the journey.
