Web Dev https://www.snakegame.com.es/ Illustrated environments, varied infected and an original tense soundtrack support this 2D survival action game on desktop and mobile.

title: Cannon Shooter Game
description: Get ready for an exciting and addictive cannon shooting adventure in Cannon Strike Fest: Smash Ball Puzzle Games! Aim your cannon, launch powerful balls, smash obstacles, and complete challenging puzzle levels filled with fun action and satisfying destruction. Test your aiming skills and strategy as you shoot balls toward targets and objects. Every level brings new challenges, obstacles, and exciting opportunities to create the perfect cannon strike. Choose the right angle, control your shots, and smash everything in your way!

title: Storm Dash
description: Run, jump and dash to escape the deadly storm! Explore colorful worlds, collect coins, upgrade your abilities and try to beat your distance record.

title: Spooky Racing
description: Spooky Racing is a Halloween kart race in full 3D! Pick one of 8 classic monsters like Dracula, the Mummy, the Witch or Jack Pumpkin, each with a kart of their own. Race through pumpkin patches, haunted swamps, a neon ghost town and a vampire castle. Grab item boxes, throw slime potions and homing ghosts, drift to charge blue, orange and purple boosts, and win gold trophies in the Grand Prix from 50cc to Mirror. Gamepad supported!

title: Signal Survival Block Arena
description: Enter a tense survival arena and race for the finish. Watch the sentinel, move only when it is safe, and avoid getting caught before time runs out. Choose from five stages, learn the timing, and guide your character through each obstacle-filled course. Includes animated characters, sound effects, keyboard controls, and an on-screen joystick for touch input. Web Dev https://www.gamesx.com.es/

title: Stickman Bow Clash
description: Stickman Bow Clash is the action-packed sequel to Stickman Archery Ragdoll! Grab your bow, take aim, and face off against rival stickmen in intense archery battles. Master your shots, use precise timing, and knock your opponents off balance with powerful arrows and hilarious ragdoll physics. Each clash is a test of aim, strategy, and reflexes. Hit the right spot, send enemies flying, and become the ultimate stickman archer! Features: Fast-paced stickman archery battles Precise bow-and-arrow aiming Fun ragdoll physics and chaotic reactions Challenge enemy stickmen in exciting duels Use timing and strategy to win each clash

title: Halloween Dentist For Kids 2
description: Even monsters need a trip to the dentist! Welcome to a Halloween clinic packed with vampires, zombies, witches and other unusual patients. Choose from 18 colorful characters and give their teeth a much-needed clean. Match each dental tool to the right problem, scrub away stains, rinse with water and use suction to clear the mouth. Need a closer look? Grab the magnifying glass! With playful cartoon artwork and simple mouse or touch controls, Halloween Dentist for Kids makes every appointment a little spooky and a lot of fun.

title: SKY HOP 3D
description: Sky Jump – The Ultimate Sky Adventure! Get ready for an exciting 3D platformer adventure! Jump across floating islands, collect shiny coins, dodge tricky obstacles, and reach the top. Explore beautiful sky worlds, test your jumping skills, and challenge yourself with every level. Can you conquer every platform and become the ultimate Sky Jump champion? Jump. Collect. Explore. Conquer the Sky!

title: Tank Push
description: Tank Push is a strategic puzzle adventure where you guide a brave frog through a dangerous battlefield. Push tanks into the correct positions, unlock gates, avoid traps, and overcome enemy defenses to escape. Every level brings new obstacles that test your logic, planning, and problem-solving skills. Think carefully, use the environment wisely, and help the little frog survive the battlefield!

title: Sniper Shooter 3D
description: Step into the role of an elite marksman in Sniper Shooter 3D! Take position on rooftops, locate dangerous criminals, aim carefully, and complete challenging sniper missions across the city.

title: Bug Crunch
description: Something is crawling across the picnic blanket, and you are the shoe. Drag to move your foot, tap for a quick stomp, hold for a ground-shaking SLAM. Squish fast to build a Splat Chain — the multiplier climbs to ×50 and the music speeds up with it. Fill the Juice vial and unleash SPLAT FEVER: ten seconds of a giant golden boot that flattens everything it touches. 40 levels, 4 worlds, 10 bugs, 4 bosses and 6 shoes to unlock. No reading required, just tap.

title: Holdem Royale
description: Holdem Royale is Texas Holdem poker with real players, live. Pull up a chair in a Wild West saloon, buy in, and outplay the table. Every player at the table buys in for the same amount, so everyone starts even. Quiet tables are topped up with house players, so theres always a game. Pick your stakes: tables from 200 to 2,500 chips, and High Stakes tables from 5,000 to 40,000 once your stack is big enough. Want to practice first? Solo tables pit you against five house players with practice chips that never touch your balance.

title: ZARUVANE   THE AMBER OASIS
description: Explore a vast desert and build your own oasis. Gather resources, manage food and water, welcome travelers to your taverns, and care for animal companions through changing days and sandstorms.

title: Bubble Rush
description: Aim from the center and pop colorful bubbles in Bubble Rush. Match bubbles of the same color, plan each shot, and clear the board. Enjoy quick puzzle rounds with simple mouse and touch controls. Use bonus options to refill or continue after an ordinary ad.

title: Octobeer
description: Welcome to Octobeer! Youre the festivals best server, and the sky is full of thirsty guests. Hold to charge, slide to aim and release to throw a beer - every guest you serve pays you coins. Each Run lasts five waves. Earn enough coins to pay the rent before its due, or the festival is over. Pick Run skills, unlock new shot styles, collect rare mugs and climb all 20 Runs of the festival. Watch your beer: every throw uses one, and when it runs dry the Run ends. Features: - Easy one-finger aiming with satisfying arcs and combos - 20 Runs with rising challenge and boss guests - Run skills, shot styles and a mug collection to complete - Hall

title: Cake Sort
description: Sort colorful cake slices to assemble whole desserts on a 4x4 grid. Enjoy relaxing clay-style 3D visuals, expanding flavors, tricky boards, and daily rewards!

title: Referee Simulator 3D
description: Referee Simulator 3D puts the whistle in your hands. Run with play, stay close to the action and make the calls that decide the match: foul or clean tackle, penalty or free kick, offside or goal, yellow or red card. Not sure? Sprint to the pitchside VAR monitor and review the incident from multiple camera angles in slow motion. Features: - 13 incident types: penalties, offsides, handballs, goal-line decisions, second yellows, elbows, corners, throw-ins and more - Real VAR reviews with offside lines and goal-line camera - Career mode: rise from the regional league to the Super League, derbies and international matches

title: Shooter: Outbreak Protocol
description: Shooter: Outbreak Protocol is a free online zombie shooting game featuring three maps and six weapons. Battle waves of undead across Raccoon City, a police station, and an Umbrella laboratory. Earn cash, unlock weapons, and upgrade your firepower to survive tougher waves. Play this first-person shooter directly in your browser.

title: Midnight Taxi Hustle
description: Navigate neon-lit streets in Midnight Taxi Hustle, a thrilling arcade driving game. Pick up eccentric passengers, beat the clock through heavy gridlock traffic, and upgrade your ride. Master the urban sprawl, dodge city chaos, and build your ultimate late-night taxi empire before dawn breaks.

title: CatchFish — Fishing Master
description: CatchFish is a free arcade fishing game. Blast schools of fish with mighty cannons, hunt huge bosses, and upgrade your arsenal from a single barrel to devastating multi-shot weapons. Mode & Levels: • Level campaign: 100 handcrafted levels with rising difficulty • Epic boss fights with huge gold bonuses Cannons (characters): • 10+ upgradeable cannons: Classic, Hexforce, Mech Storm, Frost Fang, Golden Dragon • From single barrel to devastating 4-shot multi-fire Gameplay: • Dozens of fish species with different rewards and combo streak bonuses • Progress is saved automatically in your browser • Plays great on both desktop and mobile, no insta

title: Halloween Football Championship
description: Halloween Football Championship is a supernatural 3D soccer showdown! Lead zombies, vampires, witches, or skeletons in fast-paced 5v5 matches. Outsmart defenders with quick dodges, clever passes, and unique monster abilities. Collect souls to charge your powers and strike during Blood Moon Frenzy, when every goal counts double. Jump into Quick Match or win three knockout rounds to claim the Cursed Crown!

title: Mega Noob Sky Obby: 50 Stages
description: Dash, jump, and balance your way through a massive colorful sky parkour! In this 3D platformer adventure, your mission is to guide your Noob through 50 unique stages filled with moving obstacles, winding spirals, and giant balancing spheres. Touch the checkpoints along the path to save your progress, or use the special Skip Stage feature if you get stuck on a super hard level. Complete challenges to unlock the legendary Golden Noob Character and show off your skills. Play smoothly with perfect touch controls on mobile or responsive keyboard inputs on PC!

title: GOBLOX: Grow Your Empire
description: Welcome to Sunberry Valley! Restore a forgotten garden and grow it into the greatest farming empire in the land. Plant seeds, harvest crops and sell them for coins. Then reinvest in rarer seeds, bigger plots and new regions. Weather changes everything: rain, thunderstorms, rainbow rain, meteor showers and aurora nights can mutate your crops into Gilded, Frostbound, Starborn and other valuable variants. Features: 80+ crops, from humble carrots to mythic Galaxy Lotus 17 crop mutations triggered by 15 weather types Bloom Fusion: breed two plants into brand-new hybrids 48 collectible pets with real abilities, plus pet evolution 8 unique region

title: Noob save the village
description: Upgrade your weapons, unlock powerful spells and abilities to stop the invasion of enemies. Build defenses, improve your skills and become the last hope of the village !

title: Wall Rush 3D
description: Run as fast as wind and race against all best runner in the world. Leap from buildings and vault over wall. Only the 1st winner can reach to the top of victory.

title: Obby Highest Jump Ever
description: Obby Highest Jump Ever is a click-based jumping and climbing game where every click makes you stronger. Start from a small 10M building and push your way up to massive 2500M towers as your jump power grows step by step. Each new height feels like a new milestone, and every rooftop trophy proves you earned it. Your goal is simple: jump higher, reach the top, and collect trophies. The higher the building, the bigger the reward.

title: Curve Free Kick
description: Curve Free Kick is a 3D free kick game with realistic ball physics. Move your player behind the ball and choose your run-up: the wider the angle, the more the ball curves, and the longer the run-up, the harder the shot. Bend the ball around the wall, use the wind and beat the goalkeeper. The wind blows from the left or right on every level and pushes the ball in the air. Curve with the wind for a huge swerve, or against it to cancel it out. The keeper can be fooled by both wind and spin. Features: - 12 levels, from central free kicks to tight angles near the corner flag - 10 tries, every goal gives one back - Bonus points for top corner and

title: Lumen Descent
description: Lumen Descent is a cinematic precision platformer set in a forgotten tower. Carry your light through 12 dangerous floors, master difficult jumps, dash past hazards, activate checkpoints and descend into the unknown. Navigate handcrafted obstacles, discover the towers secrets and conquer an atmospheric challenge that rewards precise timing and skill.

title: Swarmfront
description: Lead an expanding medieval army through five changing biomes in Swarmfront. Steer your squad into recruitment gates, avoid dangerous obstacles, pick strategic upgrades and overcome increasingly formidable bosses. Every fifth level introduces a distinctive boss challenge. Grow your forces, unlock useful abilities, and survive the escalating crowd-runner campaign.

title: Scary Granny: Horror Maze Escape
description: Enter the terrifying maze and try to escape before Granny finds you! Scary Granny: Horror Maze Escape is a thrilling horror adventure where every corner can hide danger. Explore creepy corridors, search for the way out, avoid Granny, and use your skills to survive the haunted maze. Stay alert, move carefully, and dont let Granny catch you! The maze is full of twists, confusing paths, and scary surprises that will keep you on edge. Can you find the exit and escape the terrifying Granny? Features Scary Granny horror gameplay Creepy maze environment Find your way to escape Suspenseful chase moments Simple and smooth contr

title: Blockland Oneblock Skyblock
description: Are you ready for an adventure that starts with a small island and a single block in the sky? In OneBlock Skyblock, use your resources wisely to expand your island, discover new resources, and build your own world. As you break the single block, different resources and surprises will appear. Expand your island, build structures, manage your resources, and become stronger as you progress. Start with a single block, build a huge island in the sky, and try to complete all the levels!

title: Boo Brew
description: Run a magical Halloween potion café in manga style! Match ingredients, stir enchanted brews and serve charming monster customers before their patience runs out. Master 12 midnight shifts, build combos, trigger rainbow fever and upgrade your witch kitchen. Easy tap-and-drag controls and an animated world of Halloween magic.

title: Category Match Puzzle
description: Category Match Puzzle is a vibrant, fun sorting game for all ages. Observe scrambled picture tiles, match items into correct categories—like toys, food, and weather—and clear the board to sharpen your brain and relax!

title: mahjong master tile sort and match
description: Mahjong Master is a classic tile-matching puzzle game. Match identical mahjong tiles in pairs to clear the board across hundreds of challenging levels. Enjoy beautiful Japanese-style scenery, soothing music, and smart power-ups like hints, shuffles, and undo. Relax your mind and become the ultimate Mahjong Master!

title: Funny Gummy Characters
description: Get ready for some crazy, wobbly fun in Funny Gummy Characters! Grab your favorite funny characters and stretch, pull, squash, and twist them into the most hilarious shapes imaginable! Watch their faces and bodies wobble, bounce, and jiggle like real jelly with funny gummy physics. There are no rules, no limits, and no wrong moves — just endless laughter and ridiculous transformations!

title: Impostor Dominion
description: Upgrade your towers, outsmart tricky enemies, and claim every stronghold on the battlefield! Strategy meets intense conquest in Impostor Dominion—deploy troops, capture rival outposts, and expand your territory until total victory is yours. Can you build the ultimate empire and dominate the map?

title: Draw to Help
description: What would you draw to help a hungry dog or a cat caught in the rain? Draw to Help is a fun puzzle game where every picture tells a little story. Figure out whats missing, draw the solution with your finger, and watch the characters react! GAME FEATURES: • Fun drawing puzzles with simple controls. • Cute characters and funny situations. • Charming hand-drawn illustrations. • Creative challenges that make you think. • Helpful hints when you get stuck. No drawing skills required. Just think, draw, and have fun!

title: Egg Wars Battle Arena 3D
description: Enter the ultimate egg battle arena! Protect your precious egg, collect resources, upgrade your equipment, and fight against rival teams in intense 3D battles. Destroy enemy eggs to prevent opponents from respawning and eliminate them from the arena. Gather materials, build defenses, improve your gear, and plan your attacks carefully. Whether you prefer defending your base or launching powerful attacks, every match offers a new challenge. Survive, conquer enemy islands, and become the last team standing!

title: Pixel Jam Bus Puzzle
description: Pixel Jam Bus Puzzle is a colorful sorting puzzle where tiny passengers form playful pixel pictures. Send vehicles into limited parking spaces, match their colors to waiting passengers, and clear each picture. Plan your moves around vehicle capacity and the colors needed next. Explore 1,000 puzzle levels with progressive difficulty and occasional easier stages. Use Clear and Shuffle helpers, pickup speed upgrades, and optional ad rewards. Play with a mouse or touch controls in portrait or landscape. Progress is saved in the current browser.

title: RICOPOP
description: RICOPOP is a neon ricochet arcade puzzle. Aim a volley, bounce balls off walls and shatter every crystal in as few shots as possible. Build chain reactions, charge the Pulse and chase three stars across 50 levels in 10 chapters. Unlock six ball styles and switch between 14 languages.

title: Try Again
description: Try Again is a tricky physics platformer. Roll your ball through 70 levels that fight back: floors that vanish, traps that wait for the perfect moment, and levels that behave differently on every attempt. Every death teaches you something. Remember where the traps hide, find the safe timing, and reach the portal. Every 10 levels a new zone and a new boss level wait for you, and new ball colors unlock as you go. Die, learn, and try again.

title: PushPlush
description: Meet the fluffiest puzzle challenge! Slide entire rows and columns to match three or more creatures of the same color. Create bombs, unlock trapped fluffies, and discover giant 2x2 characters. Complete 50 levels, solve picture puzzles, or relax in endless Zen mode. Enjoy colorful creatures, lively animations, and simple mouse or touch controls.

title: Ramp Rider Mega Bike Racing
description: Get ready for thrilling motorcycle racing in Ramp Rider Mega Bike Racing! Ride powerful bikes, conquer giant mega ramps, perform amazing jumps, and overcome challenging obstacles. Race across exciting 3D stunt tracks, master your riding skills, and reach the finish line!

title: Dinos Rush
description: Dino Rush is a colorful and addictive platform adventure where every level brings a new challenge! Run, jump, and fight your way through exciting worlds filled with dangerous obstacles, tricky platforms, enemies, and hidden rewards. Collect coins, unlock new levels, and upgrade your dinosaur to become faster and stronger. Visit the in-game shop to purchase speed upgrades, jump improvements, and powerful boosters like Golden Magnet, Feather Wings, and Coin Fever. Enjoy unlimited levels with increasing difficulty, daily rewards, achievements, and exciting challenges. Test your skills, beat your best times, and see how far you can go!

title: Open Rings
description: Open Rings is a relaxing ring puzzle about freeing gems. Every level is a tangle of faceted rings, sliding bars and little locks. Turn a ring, pull a bar and slip each piece off the board without letting anything collide. Features: - 384 levels, from gentle warm-ups to tricky tangles. - Rings, sliding bars, locks that open when other pieces are gone, and bombs that blast everything around them. - Collect diamonds to earn gems, then spend them on boosters: Hammer, Hint and Firework. - A free daily gift: 5 of every booster, every day. - Plays in 12 languages, on phone and desktop.

title: Muscle Rush 3D
description: Muscle Run is a fast-paced runner where every choice makes you stronger—or weaker! Race through colorful tracks, choose the best multiplier gates, collect protein and avoid junk food. Train at gym stations, lift weights, fight rivals and dodge dangerous obstacles. At the finish line, swing your hammer to send the puck up a towering high striker and win rewards. Unlock outfits, customize your hero, upgrade your strength, collect diamonds and conquer 100 challenging levels across five worlds!

title: Double Boy Jump
description: Guide two rope-linked heroes across tricky platforms in Double Boy Jump Press and hold to jump then release at the right moment to land safely and switch between the partners. Keep both characters out of danger as you cross gaps collect coins and aim for a higher score. Unlock character skins and explore themed modes such as Snow Dash Face to Face Cloud Ride Monster Escape and Escort Quest. With simple one-touch controls and physics-based teamwork every jump is a fresh test of timing. Play with a mouse on desktop or touch controls on mobile.

title: Pedro: Double Cross
description: Run the rooftops and expose a hidden manifest in Pedro: Double Cross, a 2D action shooter starring dual-pistol agent Noor. Explore forty connected scenes, clear each room to open its exit, and improvise with reflective rails, laser relays, breakable glass and cables. Split your aim, dodge attacks, reload behind cover and use Focus to slow the action during a risky crossing. Every shot needs a fresh press, rewarding timing and accuracy over blind spray. Detailed character animation, responsive combat effects, industrial ambience and an original electronic groove accompany the chase. Checkpoints save locally, with keyboard and mouse or touch controls available.

title: Chicken Escape
description: Chicken Escape is a 3D stealth puzzle on a colorful farm. Play as a clever chicken planning a daring escape through yards, barns and fences guarded by patrolling dogs. Your main trick is the cardboard box disguise: hide under it right in front of a guard and the dog sees just a harmless crate. But stay still while you are in its sight, or your cover is blown! Watch the glowing vision cones of the dogs, learn their patrol routes, hide behind fences and haystacks and time your dashes. Collect all golden corn grains to unlock the gate and run to the green beacon of freedom. Many levels with 3-star ratings, a tutorial level, and a wardrobe with fun skins for the chicken and the box.

title: Paint Quest Kiddo
description: Paint Quest: Kiddo! is a fun and colorful online coloring game for kids where creativity knows no limits! Pick your favorite colors, grab your virtual crayons, and bring adorable black-and-white drawings to life. Enjoy a relaxing coloring adventure filled with cool cartoon cars, cute animals, and other delightful pictures waiting for your artistic touch.

title: Spooky Vending Machine 2
description: Pick an item, enter its code, and collect your Halloween treat! Spooky Vending Machine 2 is packed with cute monster toys, colorful candy, and delightfully creepy snacks. Browse the shelves, enter the code for your favorite item, confirm your choice, and pay the displayed price to collect it. Explore the different machines and enjoy a playful Halloween world filled with glowing pumpkins, quirky creatures, and sweet treats. With simple mouse and touch controls, its easy to jump in and start collecting.

title: BEEP OUT
description: Untangle a colorful toy-town traffic jam in BEEP OUT! Tap each car to send it in the direction of its roof arrow, clear blocked lanes, and pick the right order to free the board. Across 30 levels, match vehicles with waiting passengers and manage limited parking spaces. Undo a move or use a hint when you get stuck.

title: MechaSpider: Cyber Strike
description: MechaSpider: Cyber Strike drops players into futuristic urban warzones piloting a high-tech arachnid lethal weapon. Wall-crawl across skyscrapers, deploy energy webs, and unleash high-caliber artillery. Master agile maneuvers and devastating tech abilities to crush rogue machine legions and claim total battlefield dominance.

title: Deadshift Halloween Night
description: The dead own the night. Take back the streets. DEADSHIFT: Halloween is a 3D zombie-driving game with 20 missions in a quarantined arena. Smash through the horde, collect supplies, rescue survivors, and race to extraction. Powerful collisions send zombies tumbling into ragdolls, with green splatter and impact-driven limb separation. Choose your vehicle, customize its paint, and upgrade its engine, armor, and nitro. Claim daily rewards and fight to survive all 20 nights.

title: stickman kombat 2d
description: Stickman Kombat 2D is a fast-paced fighting game where you battle stickman warriors in intense 1v1 arena combat. Choose your fighter and master punch, kick, and special attack combos to knock out your opponent. Fight through multiple levels and game modes against tougher enemies, dodge incoming blows, and chain devastating combos to win the match. Simple mouse click or tap controls make it easy to jump into action, while timing and strategy keep the combat challenging. Test your skills across a variety of stickman characters and arenas, and become the ultimate champion!

title: FRAGBYTE
description: FRAGBYTE is a fast-paced 3D first-person wave survival shooter that runs right in your browser. No downloads, 100% free. MODE: Offline single-player. Survive endless waves of enemies inside a hand-drawn ink arena. There is no final level — each wave hits harder than the last. How many waves can you survive? ENEMIES: Stickman soldiers, shield brutes, blade runners, laser snipers, and a brutal arena boss at the end of every run. ARSENAL: Assault rifle, pump shotgun, marksman sniper, katana, ink grenades, and a grapple hook. MOVEMENT: Wall-jumps, crouch-slides, and grapple-hook swings. Chain headshots to climb the score.

title: IRONWAKE: Tank Combat
description: Take command of a customizable battle tank in 10 action-packed missions. Ambush enemy convoys, capture uplinks, defend a relay, escort an evacuation vehicle, recover classified intel, and escape devastating artillery strikes. Battle two powerful bosses, including the three-phase Dreadnought. Use buildings as cover, track enemies and objectives on the minimap, and collect salvage to upgrade your armor, firepower, and mobility. Switch between four weapons and customize your tank’s appearance.

title: Pro Football Eleven 2027
description: Pro Football Eleven 2027 is a 3D football game by BREYMANTECH, played at full eleven-a-side inside the packed, floodlit Breymantech Arena. Pick from 10 European and American clubs and play with assisted controls: pass, through ball, cross and shoot with a power gauge. The match has offside, fouls, cards, set pieces, goal replays, ragdoll tackles and smart team AI. Choose your mode: Exhibition: a quick match against the CPU. BREYMANTECH Cup: an 8-club knockout tournament. Draws go straight to penalties.

title: Shadow Fist   Kung Fu
description: Shadow Fist is a fast-paced kung fu stickman beat ’em up. You play Kai, the last disciple of Master Lin, and you must take back the stolen Dragon Scroll from the Black Lotus clan. Fight through buildings floor by floor. Each level has waves of enemies, a boss at the end, and a golden key that opens the exit door. Climb ladders and ride elevators between rooms, from living rooms and kitchens to dojos and basements. Features: 5000 levels: 8 story levels with unique bosses, then thousands of generated levels with new enemy mixes and bosses Punch combos, kicks, air attacks, a spinning special move, blocking and a dash with brief invincibility SixShadow Fist is a fast-paced kung fu stickman beat em up. Play Kai, last disciple of Master Lin, and take back the stolen Dragon Scroll from the Black Lotus clan. Fight through buildings floor by floor. Each level has waves of enemies, a boss, and a golden key that opens the exit door. Climb ladders and ride elevators from living rooms and kitchen

title: Warehouse Wobble 3D
description: Drive a forklift, balance wobbly loads and deliver them in one piece! In Warehouse Wobble 3D you pick up towering stacks of boxes, fragile TVs, rolling barrels, a very heavy safe - and yes, a piano - and drive them across busy warehouses to the green delivery zone. Brake too hard and the stack topples. Take a corner too fast and your cargo goes flying. - 20 levels across 4 warehouses: Loading Dock, Cold Storage, Night Shift and the Mega Depot - Real physics: every load sways, leans and can tip over - Dodge patrol robots, time the roller doors and slide across icy floors - Earn up to 3 stars per level and collect coins - Upgrade your forklift in the garage: stronger engine, grippier tyres, stabilizer and better brakes - Progress is saved automatically - Plays on desktop and mobile (touch controls)

title: Tactical Response Team
description: In Tactical Response Team, step into the boots of an elite marksman where every shot counts. Zoom in to neutralize high-value targets, provide long-range precision support, and suppress hostile forces before they eliminate your pinned teammates. Precision, patience, and timing dictate survival.

title: People Blaster
description: Crowd Gun 3D is a fast-paced runner where you recruit stickmen along the track to transform them into powerful weapons. Pass through multipliers, dodge deadly city obstacles, and unleash a barrage of gunfire to blast through targets and reach the finish line!

title: Taiga: Expedition
description: Taiga: Expedition is a cozy 3D physics offroad delivery simulator. Drive vintage trucks through mud, deep fords and forest forks of the wild taiga and deliver logs and cargo to the sawmill. Your truck bed carries living cargo: logs, fuel barrels, blocks, pipes, hay bales and fragile containers. They sway and fly off on bumps, so feather throttle, brake and steering to keep them on board. 5 trucks: Zubr-130 Veteran, Leshy-66 4x4, Kedr-255 6x6, Utes-4320 and Cayman-6522 Taiga Beast 6x6. Upgrade engine, mud tires, suspension, high sides and fuel tank, and paint the body in six colors. 50 handcrafted routes from dirt roads to the Great Swamp, with risky shortcuts and safe detours, fords, sticky mud and boulders. Earn up to 3 stars per level for cargo kept and time.

title: Terminal Nine
description: Explore three industrial districts in a third-person stealth game. Avoid patrols, complete objectives and reach extraction across nine operations. Use crouching, physical cover and decoys to stay undetected. Earn credits for equipment upgrades, choose from three difficulty settings, and learn the controls in a separate practice yard. A three-district campaign links operations with checkpoints between missions.

title: Witchy
description: Fly with Witchy and her black cat through four magical worlds! Defeat monster waves and powerful bosses, upgrade your spells and unleash magic bombs. Recover 10 stolen amulets and save Halloween!

title: Shooter Tactical Strike
description: Play Shooter: Tactical Strike, a free online 3D FPS game featuring intense tactical combat, realistic weapons, enemy battles, and fast-paced shooting action. Aim, shoot, upgrade your weapons, and survive challenging missions directly in your browser.

title: Bucket Sort 3D
description: Get Ready for the Ultimate Color-Sorting Adventure! Body Welcome to Sand Jam: Truck Sort, where creativity meets logic! If you love satisfying puzzles and brain-teasing challenges, this is the game for you. At the top of your screen, a stunning piece of sand art is waiting to be dismantled. Below, a fleet of colorful trucks is ready for action. Your mission? Tap the trucks in the right order to match the sand colors and haul it all away!

title: Steal My Egg
description: Sneak in, grab the egg, outrun the guardian! Raid 25 wild worlds, steal rare eggs from giant guardians and run home before they catch you. Hatch 200 collectible pets, grow your garden, fight off rival thieves and unlock ridiculous bandit skins. Find giant eggs worth a fortune!

title: Cake Stack
description: Cake Stack is a fun and addictive hyper-casual game! Guide your cute yellow character as it runs along the track and stacks delicious layers of cake. Tap or click to play: dodge obstacles, collect golden coins and build your cake tower higher and higher. The game features many exciting levels, unlockable characters and skins, and a shop where you can spend your coins. Run out of moves? Watch a video to revive and keep playing! Simple one-touch controls make it perfect for players of all ages. Easy to learn, hard to master — can you build the tallest cake and set a new high score? Play Cake Stack now!

title: Apex Combat
description: Apex Combat is a fast-paced 2.5D arcade beat em up. Battle through hordes of cybernetic enemies in futuristic cyberpunk environments. Master devastating combos, unleash special abilities, and team up with friends in intense cooperative combat packed with classic arcade action.

title: Super Chop: Forest Hero
description: Pull the Hero Axe out of the old stump and become the mightiest lumberjack in the forest! Chop trees, fill your backpack with logs and fly them to the truck to sell for coins. Buy stronger tools, from Twin Axes and Power Gauntlets to the Hero Saw, Thunder Axe and Plasma Cutter, and upgrade your strength, backpack, speed and Hero Flight. Unlock six forest zones, from Oak Woods to the Redwood Giants, where every tree is worth more. Battle the giant Elder Trees, smash the rot rigs of Baron Blight, clear monster dens for rare materials and relics, rescue forest animals and rebuild the village to earn a beaver helper, a frost pup and a double jump. Plant rare seeds in your own grove, dig up buried treasure and collect new hero gloves. Play solo or online with up to 8 heroes!

title: Sniper for Brainrot
description: Use your sniper rifle to hit the balloon above a Brainrot, instantly transform into it, and race to the Safe Zone before a massive tsunami catches you. The farther you shoot, the rarer the Brainrot you can collect but the faster the wave becomes. Build your collection, expand your Base, unlock powerful sniper rifles, customize your character, and compete with friends in this addictive Brainrot adventure featuring 87 unique collectibles!

title: Final Fight: Harbor Justice
description: Take back the waterfront in Final Fight: Harbor Justice, an arcade-style 2D brawler with two playable fighters. Choose powerful Nessa or quick-footed Ivo, explore the docks and city blocks, and face patrols with readable attack warnings. Punch, jump, block, grab and throw enemies, pick up pipes, and smash crates for supplies. Fight through the scrolling campaign, demolition bonus rounds and boss encounters while local checkpoints keep your progress safe. Detailed character artwork, recorded impacts, waterfront ambience and an original arcade groove bring the uprising to life. Play with keyboard and mouse or on-screen touch controls.

title: Holecraft.io
description: Enter a chaotic block-eating adventure where size is everything! Control a hungry black hole, move around the map, and swallow blocks, objects, and structures to grow larger. Start small and consume everything you can find to increase your size and power. As you grow, bigger blocks become available and you can clear the environment faster. Compete against the clock, collect as much as possible, and become the biggest hole on the map. How large can you grow?

title: Sniper: Silent Ridge
description: Eliminate every hostile. Aim for the head for a bonus. The small scope pip predicts wind and bullet drop at the displayed range. Space, click or tap Skip to shorten the bullet camera. Fuel drums damage nearby guards. Crouch and wait to reduce alert.

title: Dressup Wheel
description: Spin the wheel to answer style questions, create four unique outfits with matching jewelry and accessories, and dress up your fashion doll for any event!

title: 2244 Number Match
description: Challenge your brain with 2244 Number Game, a fun and addictive number-matching puzzle! Swipe and merge identical number tiles to create bigger numbers and aim for 2048, 4096, and beyond. Move tiles in 8 directions, plan your moves carefully, and build the highest score possible. Enjoy daily rewards, powerful boosters, timed challenges, global leaderboards, and customizable themes including City, Jungle, Desert, Snow, and Aquarium. Whether you have a few minutes or want a longer brain-training session, 2244 offers relaxing yet challenging gameplay for everyone. Test your logic, improve your strategy, and see how far you can merge!

title: Orbit Pals
description: Orbit Pals is a cozy space sorting puzzle with adorable alien pals. Tap a planet to lift the pals at its edge, then tap another planet to make them hop over. Gather every species into its own flock - each planet fits only four! Levels: endless generated levels with 3-star ratings, a tutorial, and home-planet levels from level 15. Modes: Daily Puzzle with streaks and Star Pals rewards. Characters: 9 kinds of pals and 81 hybrids to create in the Lab. Plus a Home Planet that earns coins while youre away, a Cosmic Wheel and planet styles. 7 languages, desktop and mobile.

title: Line Color 2D
description: Line Color 2D es un adictivo puzle donde mantienes presionado para deslizar la línea de color por un circuito plano. Planifica cada movimiento, esquiva los obstáculos en movimiento y pinta la ruta completa en 2D hasta cruzar la meta en este reto tan relajante como desafiante.

title: Cop Ramp Sandbox
description: Steer open-world chaos in Cop Ramp Sandbox! Take the wheel of high-speed police cruisers, launch off massive mega-ramps, and execute jaw-dropping stunts. Unleash pure vehicular destruction, customize your rides, and dominate the ultimate physics-based stunt playground with unrestricted driving freedom!

title: Meow Sudoku
description: Welcome to the classic logic game with a fresh twist! Rely on colors and deduction to organize the board. Discover challenges that will put your spatial perception and strategic thinking to the test. How far will you be able to go?

title: Block Tower Smash
description: Smash your way down a spinning tower of colorful blocks! Hold to crash your ball through the rings, let go to bounce, and never touch the dark blocks or your ball breaks. Endless levels across six worlds: Meadow, Desert, Snowfield, Caves, Jungle and the Lava Depths. Each level gets taller and trickier, with more dark blocks to dodge. Chain 10 smashes in a row to start Diamond Mode and blast through anything, even dark blocks. Smash the yellow Lucky Blocks for one of 14 surprise effects: Low Gravity, Gem Rain, Upside Down, Mega Ball, Glass Tower, Bubble Shield, Fireworks, a chicken ball and more. Collect them all in the Effect Book.

title: Bus Mania: Parking Puzzle
description: Bus Shift: Parking Jam is a colorful and addictive parking puzzle game where every move matters. Tap buses to move them in the direction of their arrows, clear the crowded parking area, and match passengers with the correct colored buses. Plan your moves carefully, avoid blocking other vehicles, and find the right order to clear each traffic jam. Levels become increasingly challenging with new layouts, obstacles, and tricky situations. With simple controls, bright 3D graphics, satisfying animations, and fun logic-based gameplay, Bus Shift: Parking Jam is easy to learn but challenging to master. Can you clear every parking jam and get all pass

title: Pumpkin Ninja
description: Pumpkin Ninja is a fast and addictive Halloween arcade game! Slice flying pumpkins with quick swipes, create huge combos and avoid the dangerous bombs. Play across spooky Halloween environments filled with haunted castles, moonlight, fog, rain and atmospheric effects. Master different game modes including Classic, Arcade and relaxing Zen Mode, beat your high score and become the ultimate Pumpkin Ninja!

title: Lollipop Escape Mania Kids
description: Lollipop Escape Mania Kids is a kids game where playing has been made very easy. There are platforms filled with candies and you have supposed to collect all of them to increase your score. There are enemy objects too that you have to avoid but they are very few. Have fun :)

title: Crazy Plinko
description: At first it feels random. Then patterns appear. With each upgrade you influence gravity, angles and timing. The board stops being chaos and becomes a system you can master. But are your choices smart enough to succeed?

title: Build a Keycap Pyramid
description: Build a Keycap Pyramid is a satisfying 3D building game where every keycap counts. Scoop up keycaps by the hundreds, carry a wobbling tower of them on your head and watch your pyramid rise layer by layer. Every finished pyramid is saved to your plot with your name on top, and the next one is even bigger! Chain combos and hunt for gold (x10) and rainbow (x50) keycaps. Get stronger on benches and treadmills: type the letter that pops up for a perfect rep. Hatch 15 Keycap Pets that boost your keys, cash and training. Defend your pyramid from Glitch raiders by throwing keycaps, and type the word to break the shield of their boss. Make it yours with 5 pyramid shapes, 10 color palettes and your name in keycaps on top. Share a live world with up to 3 other builders and cheer with emotes. Builder bots keep earning while you are away, and there are daily challenges and a 7-day reward calendar.

title: GeometryRush
description: Geometry Rush is an addictive arcade runner! Control a cute cube character as it dashes through a colorful geometric world. Jump over spikes, dodge obstacles and collect coins across multiple challenging levels. With simple one-tap controls, smooth gameplay and vibrant graphics, anyone can pick it up and play instantly. The game features progressive difficulty, checkpoints and a fun practice mode to master each course. How far can you rush?

title: Home Hauler Simulator
description: Home Hauler Simulator lets you drive heavy trucks and operate precision cranes to construct custom houses from scratch. Transport floors, walls, and roofs across challenging terrains, master complex machinery, complete rewarding residential contracts, and build your dream construction enterprise from the ground up!

title: Architects of Tomorrow
description: Shape the skyline of tomorrow in this strategic urban builder. Blueprint sprawling metropolises, balance complex resource networks, and adapt to dynamic environmental challenges. From humble zoning to towering high-tech hubs, test your visionary leadership and engineer a thriving, sustainable future for generations to come. Web Dev https://www.bestcrazygames.com/

title: Zombie Drift: Steel Rage
description: Zombie Drift: Steel Rage is a post-apocalyptic 3D action game that mixes arcade drifting with arena survival. Drive an armored battle car into a ruined city arena full of zombie hordes and mutant giants. Speed and controlled slides are your weapons: the sharper the drift, the faster your nitro rage builds and the harder your spiked bumper hits - up to 2.5x ramming damage. Mow down walkers and runners, blow up barrels and collect scrap gears. Campaign of 100 levels in 10 chapters with 20 titan bosses, plus endless survival mode. Unlock the Iron Fang, the Dune Reaper buggy and the heavy War Titan, upgrade armor and turbo, and pick weapon modules between waves: miniguns, buzzsaws, flamethrowers and rocket mortars.

title: Leaf Clean Up
description: Start from scratch with your bare hands, collecting fallen leaves and dropping them off at the sell zone for cash. Step onto glowing upgrade pads to boost your bag capacity, suction radius, and movement speed. As you expand through multiple themed worlds, unlock powerful tools including the Leaf Blower for quick sweeping and the heavy-duty Lawnmower for instant mulching.

title: Find The Key
description: Find The Key is a challenging maze puzzle game where you explore tricky paths, collect stars, and find the key to unlock the exit. Plan every move carefully to reach hidden stars without getting trapped. Once you collect enough stars, grab the key and open the path to the goal. With increasingly complex mazes and strategic gameplay, FindTheKey will test your logic, patience, and problem-solving skills!

title: Flappy Halloween Game
description: Get ready for a spooky and exciting flying adventure in Flappy Halloween Game! Take control of a cute Halloween-themed character and fly through challenging obstacles while trying to achieve the highest score. Tap, click, or press to keep your character in the air and carefully navigate through the Halloween obstacles. The game is easy to learn but becomes increasingly challenging as you try to beat your previous high score.

title: Demon Hunter: Beat Em Up
description: Doom 2016 reimagined as an illustrated arcade beat em up. Rip and tear through five chapters with melee combos, a shotgun, and Berserk.

title: Dark Ages: Beat Em Up
description: Doom: The Dark Ages reimagined as an illustrated arcade beat em up. Master the flail, Shield Saw, parry, and shotgun across five chapters.

title: StickNinja Mission
description: Enter a fast-paced 2D platform adventure where every level is filled with danger! Control your ninja, defeat monsters in your path, collect the keys, and unlock mysterious doors to continue your mission. Jump across platforms, avoid deadly traps, fight dangerous enemies, and discover the right path through challenging levels. Improve your skills, master your attacks, and survive every encounter. Can you defeat every monster, find every key, and complete the StickNinja Mission?

title: Cheerleader Magazine Dressup
description: Design trendy cheerleader outfits, apply glamorous makeovers, style hair, and create stunning looks for photoshoots in this fun fashion dress-up game!

title: Cliff Boi Trap Adventure
description: Cliff Boi: Fail = Try Again! is a hilarious and addictive 2D cartoon side-scrolling platformer and trap adventure game! Guide a cute chibi boy with round glasses across 25 action-packed stages filled with unexpected surprises, collapsing bridges, and funny traps. Run forward across towering canyon cliffs, leap over wide chasms, and grab onto cliff ledges to climb your way to safety! Just when you think the path to the GOAL sign is clear, watch out for sudden pop-up floor spikes, spring-loaded boxing gloves, swinging spiked wrecking balls, 100-ton falling sky anvils, speeding soccer balls, sneaky rock beetles, and lightning storm clouds! Fea

title: Block Ship Battle
description: Raise the sails and fight for the richest hold on the reef! Block Ship Battle is a fast pirate brawler with real broadside combat: your cannons fire to the side, so every fight is a dance of turning, timing and reloading until your guns bear on the enemy — then KABOOM. Sink ships, scoop up floating treasure and carry your gold to a harbour — only banked gold counts, and a fat hold makes you the target everyone is hunting. Hunt the Treasure Galleon, sail into storms for the treasure they wash up, and level up during the match: every level fits your ship with a new upgrade you can see, up to your captains ultimate. Six ships and captains, each with two abilities and an ultimate. Five modes, from Plunder Brawl to Last Ship Afloat, a sixteen-ship battle royale inside a closing storm. Your progress is saved: unlock new ships, sails and paint as you play.

title: Grave Blast
description: Grave Blast is a fast-paced 3D twin-stick survival shooter set in a spooky Halloween world. Fight endless waves of simple voxel-style zombies in creepy locations full of pumpkins, graves, moonlight and eerie atmosphere. Move quickly, shoot in all directions and survive as long as possible while blasting enemies into chunky red pieces. With simple controls, arcade action and mobile-friendly gameplay, Grave Blast delivers fun zombie carnage in a colorful low-poly style. Perfect for players who love action, survival and Halloween games.

title: Collect Brainrot Arena
description: Collect Brainrot Arena is a chaotic multiplayer collecting and stealing game where luck, strategy, and timing are equally important. Enter the arena, gather valuable Lucky Blocks, unlock rare Brainrots, upgrade your collection, and protect your base from rival thieves. Every Lucky Block can contain a surprise, and every opponent is looking for an opportunity to steal your most valuable Brainrots.

title: Tidy Bot
description: Tidy Bot is a relaxing 3D cleaning game. Drive a little robot vacuum around cosy rooms, suck up every speck of dirt, collect coins and get back to the dock before the battery runs out. Play 30 handmade levels across living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms and dining rooms, then try Endless mode, which builds a brand new room every round. Spend coins on battery, speed and side brush upgrades, and choose Easy, Medium or Hard difficulty. Your progress is saved automatically, and the game works on desktop and mobile.

title: Soccer Rebound
description: Soccer Rebound is football played on a pinball table. You control the two flippers in front of your own goal, and your toy teammates do the running: they chase the ball, pass it and shoot on their own. Keep the ball out of your net, bank it off the side rails to get round the keeper, flip it up to your playmaker for a first-time finish, and from stage 4 use the Bend Shot to curl your next flip round a defender.

title: Bean Party Obby
description: Bean Party Obby is a colorful 3D party game where you race, jump and survive against 14 computer-controlled beans. Pick one of 6 bean characters and a hat, then choose one of 5 modes. Three obby courses: Rainbow Road (easy), High Peaks (ramps, bridge, trampoline, spinning beams) and Turbo Galaxy (fast roads, big jumps, sliding platforms). Hexagon Survival: four layers of hexagons vanish under your feet, be the last bean standing. Color Block: run to the announced color before the other tiles fall, for 12 rounds. Double jump, speed boosts and checkpoints help you. Plays on desktop and mobile.

title: Ramp Truck Mayhem
description: Unleash the roar of the monster truck Bandit as you launch off massive wooden ramps and soar across epic arenas! Experience heart-pounding stunt jumps, explosive exhaust flames, and high-speed thrills as you fly past the checkered flag to claim victory. Web Dev https://www.mentolatux.com.es/

title: EmberCraft
description: EmberCraft is a colorful 3D sandbox adventure in a block world. Explore varied terrain, build your own creations, and shape your journey at your own pace. The game is designed for desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers. On a phone, rotate to landscape for the best view.

title: Nutty Rush
description: Nutty Rush is a cozy 3D platformer starring Pöfürdük, a brave little squirrel. The legendary giant nuts of the Great Forest are waking up, and the greedy eagle Grimtalon wants them all. Run, jump and spit nuts at grumpy foes across 5 colorful worlds: Nut Forest, Autumn Valley, Dark Cave, Snowy Mountains and City Rooftops. Team up with Sivri, a cheeky grey mouse, and ride on his back for extra speed. Zoom down twisty slides into ball pits, collect stars and giant nuts, and face big bosses: dodge their attacks, then hit them with nuts when they are open! Features: 25 handcrafted levels in 5 worlds, a boss fight at the end of every world, ride your mouse buddy Sivri, and your progress is saved automatically.

title: Coinbound Voodoo Nightmare
description: Coin Bound is a fastpaced arcade runner where every second counts. Dash through tight maze paths, grab coins, dodge zombies, and push your score higher with every run. Simple controls, quick rounds, and nonstop pressure make it perfect for instant play. More than a dozen levels. And almost a score of Zombies to best. Pick your gender and run! How long can you survive the chase?

title: Pixel Shooter Puzzle
description: Pixel Shooter Puzzle is a colorful 3D puzzle game where every cannon choice counts. Choose cannons from the front of the queue to blast matching blocks from a rotating voxel model. Reveal the layers underneath, plan around limited slots, and clear 200 pixel puzzles. Rotate and zoom to inspect each model, and use optional boosts when you need a hand. Progress is saved in the current browser.

title: Dog Runaway
description: You slipped the leash. Your owner is already running. Do not stop. Dog Runaway is a 3D arcade chase: sprint through six worlds, make a mess, stay free. SIX WORLDS, each with its own rules: The Park, Downtown, The Forest, The Zombie Zone, Junk Food Heaven, and a peaceful walk where nobody chases you at all. SIX DOGS TO UNLOCK: Pug, German Shepherd, Husky, Shiba Inu, Fox and Wolf. Each runs and turns differently, and two of them shrug off the first catch. MISSIONS, NOT A SCORE TREADMILL. Find the hidden bone. Water the flowers. Nose the ball into the blue ring. Drop a poop to jam the chase. Skim past your owner by a whisker for bonus treats

title: SCRAP ARMS NEO
description: This is my very first game, and I sincerely hope you all enjoy playing it! SCRAP ARMS NEO is a pixel-art action roguelite. Every weapon you pick up joins your stack and attacks automatically - until it breaks and explodes. Swap weapons on the fly, choose an upgrade at every level-up, unleash Full Burst, and survive waves of scrap monsters and bosses. - 60 weapons, from crowbars to legendary guns - 6 playable characters, each with a unique skill - 9 stages with boss fights, plus a harder Back side - Bring your surviving weapons home and spend your score on the weapon gacha - Plays on PC and mobile (portrait and landscape)

title: Last Garage: Zombie Road
description: Hit the road in Last Garage, a fast-paced 3D zombie survival driving game. Race through shifting districts—from city streets and suburbs to a forest highway—while dodging wrecks, fallen trees, barriers, and evacuation traffic. Fight walkers, armored brutes, and the towering Colossus with machine guns and rockets. Collect scrap, fuel, and ammo during each run, then use your haul to repair and upgrade your vehicle between runs. Choose from four vehicles and improve your armor, engine, weapons, and nitro. Complete challenges and achievements as you push deeper into the outbreak. One of three lanes is always open, but four crashes or an empty tan

title: Grass Rush Adventure
description: Cut grass, discover rare treasures, and grow stronger with every swing! Grass Rush Adventure is a colorful incremental game where you explore six worlds and uncover more than 300 collectible treasures. Sell your finds to buy stronger tools, expand your backpack, and upgrade your cutting range, speed, luck, and pickup reach. Equip magical auras and rebirth for permanent Strength and Gold bonuses that help you push further. Complete Magic Plant quests, explore the treasure-filled Daily Garden, and hunt for your next big discovery. Start with a simple sickle and work your way toward powerful fantasy weapons!

title: Aberiel Church Jigsaws
description: Escape the noise of daily life and embark on a peaceful journey through the world’s most beautiful churches in Aberiel Church Jigsaw Puzzles Saga — Chapter 1. Explore stunning churches from around the world while solving relaxing jigsaw puzzles. Choose from 12, 20, or 42 pieces and rebuild each image at your own pace. Created with carefully retouched artwork, the game combines relaxing puzzle gameplay with a worldwide architectural journey. Complete each church to unlock the next and continue your journey from one remarkable place of worship to another.

title: Last Call: Drunken Boxer
description: Last Call: Drunken Boxer drops you into a tactical 3D boxing game where unpredictable ragdoll knockdowns and dramatic ringside action define every bout. Four fighters, each carrying unique special moves, stand ready before you choose your path — a single opponent or a full tournament of 12 rivals. Several scenes show humanoid figures composed of simple oval limbs and sphere-shaped heads lining the ring perimeter.

title: Jenni Styles
description: A little fashion, a little adventure, and one big day! Join Jenni and her kitty Bubbles in a colourful dress-up story. Choose her replies, pick from four complete looks, and help her get ready for whatever comes next—from everyday outings to spotlight moments. A cheerful, all-ages remake of the original 2014 Flash game, Jenni Styles.

title: Double Dragon: Broken District
description: Double Dragon: Broken District is a martial arts story through four missions. Choose Mina or Ken and fight beside an AI sibling to find a missing trainer after your dojo burns. Chain punches and kicks, dodge enemy windups, throw foes, carry staffs and unleash Twin Spirit attacks. Web Dev https://www.friv.org.es/ Three encounters per chapter, distinct bosses, checkpoints, touch controls and an original arcade-inspired soundtrack bring the district to life.

title: Finnie Escape
description: Finnie Escape is an exciting underwater puzzle adventure where you guide a little fish through mysterious ocean mazes. Move across grid-based paths, avoid dangerous enemies, interact with the environment, and use special abilities to survive. Each level introduces new obstacles and tougher challenges that test your logic, strategy, and timing. Find the safest path and help Finnie escape the deep ocean!

title: Fashion Show Dressup

Grab +1 pickups: when your ball tray overflows, twin balls merge into mightier elementals with burn, freeze, chain lightning and more. Every 10 rows a boss enrages; beat it to set a checkpoint. Buy the glowing upgrade, collect launchers and ball skins, and chase the Daily Barrage.

title: Leaf Blower Yards
description: Drive a ride-on leaf blower through yards buried in autumn leaves. Your air stream gathers the leaves into a pile in front of the nozzle. Drive the pile into the bag zone: every 50 leaves fill a bag and pay coins. When a yard is clear, the lawn shows a picture.

description: 4 in a Blow is Connect 4 with power-ups. Everyone already knows the rules, so you can start playing immediately. Every turn charges up your power meter — spend it to block a column, swap two tokens, remove a token, or drop twice in a row. The one rule that keeps it fair: a power can never win the game on its own. It can only set up or defend a win, so the final move is always a normal drop. Play Classic for pure Connect 4 against AI or a friend, Blast for the full power-up experience, or Wakie for a fast 90-second score-attack mode with rotating powers and a Turbo Time finish. Simple to learn, hard to see coming.

description: Play Shooter: Zombie Survival online. Fight zombie waves for cash, buy and upgrade weapons, then unlock the final wave by completing your arsenal.

Expect the unexpected: watch for traps, learn from each death and try again.

Daily rewards, a daily tower and rebirths keep the speed climbing.

Collect materials, improve your equipment, expand your base, and do everything you can to survive in this challenging adventure!

Plan each move carefully as every ball slides in the same direction until hitting an obstacle or another ball. Solve creative levels, overcome tricky layouts, and master increasingly challenging puzzles. With vibrant graphics, satisfying physics, and strategic gameplay, every move tests your logic and spatial skills!

title: Arms Race
description: Arms Race is a fast-paced game where you merge duplicate weapons to forge an increasingly devastating arsenal. Combine identical firearms to unlock higher-tier guns, boost your firepower, and continuously escalate your combat potential in an addictive, endless pursuit of total battlefield dominance.

description: Dive into Mathematics Frenzy, a fast-paced runner game where quick calculations are your key to victory! Collect every key to open the exit before the hourglass runs out, grab coins and gems, and avoid spikes, crumbling tiles and moving blocks. 150 handcrafted levels across 10 themed worlds, plus 30 bonus and 10 hidden levels, with a star rating for every stage.
